jobs.title: 10 Day Facility Coordinator
jobs.description:
10 Day Facility Coordinator / Facility Technician

Triumvirate Environmental, one of the largest environmental services firms in North America, is seeking a Facility Technician for our Davie team.

As a Facility Technician, you will be involved with multiple aspects of facility waste management. This is a unique role that will give you exposure to RCRA and DOT compliance, technical services, transportation, solid disposal coordination, ten-day transfer of hazardous waste and universal waste management. It is our hope that with the right training, mentoring, and experience, you will be able to grow and manage your own Triumvirate Waste Facility.

Triumvirate Environmental provides leading organizations in the higher education, life sciences, healthcare, and advanced manufacturing sectors with diverse services and expertise to assist them with compliance management. At Triumvirate Environmental, we strive to WOW both our employees and our customers. Our unique culture fosters growth, development, education, and creativity.

This position reports to our Operations Manager. This role is onsite and is based in Davie, FL.

Responsibilities:

• Develop the knowledge and experience to manage a permitted facility.

• Understand facility permit and local governing agency expectations for waste management.

• Assist with general facility compliance including performing daily/weekly/monthly compliance checks, training, SOP implementation/review, and process review.

• Assist with general facility operations including serving as management if the facility manager is not available.

• Consolidate waste according to permits, disposal facility requirements, and customer preferences.

• Assist with waste determinations/profile management.

• Coordinate outbound loads- setting up deliveries, scheduling transporters, etc.

• Develop an understanding of OSHA regulations, Triumvirate’s Health and Safety Practices, and EPA regulations.

• Demonstrate your supervisory leadership abilities through interaction with coworkers.

• Work towards becoming familiar with technical, customer service, and business components of environmental services.

• Work with computerized waste tracking systems.

• Upon completion of emergency response (ER) training, you will be part of an in-house ER team.

• Drive a forklift.

• Rotating on-call responsibilities as part of our Emergency Response team (optional)

Basic Requirements:

• Ability to work as a member of a team as well as individually.

• Customer service orientation.

• Comfortable using computers.

• Valid driver’s license in good standing.

• Successful completion of a physical examination and drug screening is required prior to employment.

• Must be able to lift 50-75 pounds.

• Must be eligible to work in the United States without future sponsorship

• Must have a reliable form of transportation

• Must be willing to consent to Motor Vehicle Record screening, criminal background check, pre-employment physical, and drug screen (inclusive of THC)

• Upon employment, you will be required to participate in a random drug screening program (inclusive of THC) as part of our company’s commitment to maintaining a safe and healthy work environment

• Must be able to lift 60 pounds on a regular basis

• Ability to work overtime on a regular basis

• Must be willing to work flexible hours within the work week (Monday through Friday)

• Must be able to report to designated office within 1 hour during Emergency Response rotating shifts

• The position frequently handles hazardous chemicals and biological waste and is responsible for putting on and taking off personal protective equipment. This role is considered safety-sensitive.

Preferred Requirements:

• Prior knowledge, experience, and compliance with DOT, RCRA, and other applicable regulations.

• Commercial Driver’s License (CDL).

• Prior relevant industry experience

• Active HAZWOPER 24 or 40 hour certification

• Willingness to obtain Commercial Driver’s License (CDL)

#LI-Onsite

Besides Health, Dental and Vision Insurance, we contribute to a 401k, offer a generous tuition reimbursement program, TONS of safety training for some positions with opportunities for external trainings and certifications, Mentorship & Career Succession Planning, Relocation Opportunities, Auto/Home insurance discounts, pet assistance discount plans, discounted movie passes & more!

To learn more about our business, culture, and the exciting work that we are doing in the industry, find us on LinkedIn, Instagram (@triumvirateenvironmental), or our website!

Triumvirate Environmental is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. As an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE), Triumvirate does not discriminate based on race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Individuals with Disabilities and Protected Veterans are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Freelance Senior Campaign Manager US
jobs.description:
ABOUT KYRA

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle — creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.



Fully remote · Freelance, up to 3 months with potential for extension · Multiple roles

across verticals · Must work 9am to 6pm Eastern Time (ET)

Immediate start. We have freelance campaign roles available right now, and we're looking to fill them quickly.




FREELANCE OPPORTUNITIES

We're hiring freelance Senior Campaign Managers across four verticals: AI and tech, fintech, sports and beauty. Each freelancer works predominantly with one client.

Our clients want to be great at creator marketing, and they move quickly. Briefs evolve once a campaign is live, and our best campaign managers enjoy shaping them with the client.






YOUR ROLE

- You own the account and are the first point of contact for the client and Client Solutions

- You lead client conversations on scope, budget and performance

- A director sets the strategy, and you deliver it end to end

- You manage a Campaign Manager and keep quality high on busy accounts




TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE

Commercial

- You hit the CPV or CPM agreed with the client. You watch reach and engagement closely and shift budget or creators mid-campaign to stay on target

- You negotiate rates that fit the budget, and creators are keen to work with us again

- When a client wants to add a link in bio or a repost, you scope and cost it with them first



Casting

- Your casting lists are culturally spot on and go beyond the usual names, often to creators we haven't discovered yet

- You turn a brief like "performance marketer who's also a TikTok creator" into clear search filters

- Your creator briefs and scripts get the content right first time

- You hold every piece of content to a high standard before it reaches the client



Platform, AI and data

- You're running full campaigns in our platform from day one: discovery, casting, outreach, contracts, payments and reporting. Experience with other influencer marketing tech platforms is a huge plus

- Your outreach works at volume and still feels personal

- AI is part of your daily workflow for research, outreach and briefs, and you check its

output

- You know TikTok, Instagram and YouTube analytics inside out



Complexity

- Complex, bespoke accounts are your comfort zone, and that experience carries over to high-volume work

- You've freelanced in agile, fast-moving teams, like a big beauty group, an agency or a

tech start-up. You get up to speed quickly and adapt when priorities shift



Communication and leadership

- Your writing is clear and confident, and everyone knows what's happening

- Clients hear from you before they need to ask, and your performance updates are easy to follow

- You stay composed on tough client calls and keep the relationship strong

- You flag risks early, with a fix in mind

- Leadership gets honest numbers from you, including when results are behind

- You give your Campaign Manager clear direction and useful feedback

- You build strong relationships with our Client Solutions and Strategy teams, and with your creators

We're growing our beauty team fast. If you've worked with beauty or fragrance brands, we'd especially love to hear from you.




WHAT YOU BRING

- 5+ years in influencer marketing, talent management or campaign management

- Experience owning enterprise client relationships

- Experience leading or mentoring a more junior campaign manager

- A solid grasp of how influencer campaigns run end to end

- Hands-on experience with influencer marketing platforms for discovery, outreach and reporting

- Creator negotiation and contracting experience, including usage rights

- Campaign experience and strong US cultural knowledge in AI and tech, fintech, sports or beauty

- Availability 9am to 6pm Eastern Time (ET), Monday to Friday. This is mandatory,

wherever you're based




THE CONTRACT

- Up to 3 months, with a strong likelihood of extension

- Paid on a day rate. Include yours when you apply

- Fully remote




HOW THE PROCESS WILL RUN

1. Send us your CV, your day rate and the vertical you're applying for.

2. If you're shortlisted, we'll invite you to complete our casting challenge, where you build a creator list for a sample brief in our platform. It's a chance to show us your taste and get a feel for how we work.

3. You'll have a short conversation with a member of our talent team and the campaign lead.



AI in your application

AI is core to how we operate. Use it to elevate your work. Everything in your application should reflect your own judgement and experience.

Sound like you? We'd love to hear from you.

💟 Support

If you have a condition or require an adjustment to our interview process - please let us know so we can make adjustments to support you. Please note that when you submit an application or resume, your data will be processed in line with our privacy policy https://www.bamboohr.com/legal/privacy-policy.

 - Je bent het aanspreekpunt op locatie: je werkt samen met zorgteams om te zorgen dat ons product in de praktijk goed werkt.

 - Je lost problemen snel op: je onderscheidt operationele en technische issues en schakelt waar nodig door.

 - Je bevordert actief gebruik van ons product: je werkt met belangrijke gebruikers en zorgt dat teams Tandem blijven inzetten.

 - Je verzamelt gestructureerd feedback en koppelt concrete verbeterpunten terug naar onze Product en Engineering teams.

 - Je ondersteunt veiligheids- en kwaliteitscontroles volgens interne processen.

 - Je werkt samen met onze commerciele- en support teams om implementaties succesvol te maken.



Wie jij bent:

 - Je krijgt energie van het verbeteren van medische werkprocessen en het verminderen van administratieve druk voor zorgverleners.

 - Je hebt ervaring in of met ziekenhuizen (een medische achtergrond is mooi meegenomen, maar niet vereist).

 - Je bent pragmatisch en gestructureerd: je zorgt dat implementaties soepel verlopen en dat iedereen weet wat er moet gebeuren.

 - Je denkt vanuit het perspectief van de eindgebruiker: je let op gebruiksgemak, werkprocessen en hoe zorgverleners software écht ervaren.

 - Je vindt het leuk om gebruikers te trainen en bent graag aanwezig op locatie wanneer een nieuwe organisatie live gaat.

 - Je communiceert helder en werkt makkelijk samen met zorgverleners, operationele teams en IT.

 - Je werkt nauwkeurig en hebt oog voor veiligheid, zeker in complexere zorgomgevingen.

 - Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands en Engels.



Pluspunten:

 - Je hebt ervaring met het introduceren van nieuwe producten en/of systemen binnen de zorg

 - Je bent bekend met ziekenhuis-EPD’s en verslagleggingsprocessen.

 - Je hebt ervaring in acute zorg of in multidisciplinaire teams.



Wat je krijgt:

 - De kans om door te groeien in je carrière en tegelijk een betekenisvolle bijdrage te leveren aan de toekomst van de zorg binnen een snelgroeiende Europese healthtech scale-up

 - Een marktconform salaris.

 - Regelmatige teamuitjes en sociale activiteiten.

 - Een hondvriendelijk kantoor.



Locatie

Dit is een fulltime functie op ons kantoor in Leiden. Je reist regelmatig binnen Nederland en bent tijdens de livegang van een nieuw ziekenhuis soms langere periodes op locatie.


CULTURE AT TANDEM


At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

jobs.description:
ABOUT AGENTIO

Agentio enables marketers to buy creator led ads as easily and scalably as Meta or Google ads—automating sourcing, pricing, contracting, delivery, and measurement with AI—so work that took months now happens in minutes.

We’re on a mission to transform a $800B digital ad ecosystem by shifting digital ad spend into the hands of creators. That means better outcomes for marketers and enabling creators to live off their work—finally being paid in proportion to the value they create. That shift is accelerating: Unilever’s CEO has said the company will move roughly half of its ad budget into social and creators—Unilever is among the world’s largest advertisers, spending around $9–10B annually. As these dollars move, they need performance-grade pipes; Agentio is how those dollars flow to creators with the speed, control, and measurement marketers expect. We enable brands like Uber, DoorDash, and Bombas to run creator campaigns with the same rigor, control, and accountability as their core performance channels.

Agentio has raised $56M to date at a $340M valuation, including a recent Series B led by Forerunner https://techcrunch.com/2025/11/18/agentio-secures-40-million-from-forerunner-as-it-scales-its-creator-marketplace-beyond-youtube/, which followed our Series A within a calendar year. You

jobs.title: Business Development Representative - Outbound
jobs.description:
Join AutogenAI – Revolutionizing Proposal Writing with generative AI

AutogenAI is a leader in generative AI SaaS, transforming how organizations draft and optimize winning proposals through cutting-edge natural language processing technology. We are one of the fastest-growing AI companies in the world, expanding rapidly to meet the increasing demand for AI-driven solutions across industries.

Our innovaion stems from a belief that language AI technology will revolutionize business communication over the next decade. We empower our clients to grow faster and more efficiently by delivering AI language engines customized to their needs that save time, improve content quality, and increase win rates in highly competitive markets.

AutogenAI is a company where everyone can have a career-defining experience and success is achieved by fostering a culture where innovation and ambition thrive. As we scale, passionate professionals are invited to join our journey of innovation, helping shape the future of AI-powered business solutions.

About this opportunity

As a BDR at AutogenAI, you'll be joining the US commercial team at the point where our fastest growth is happening. You'll have direct exposure to experienced sales leaders, work shoulder-to-shoulder with Account Executives and our product team and own the first conversation with some of the largest contractors in the country.

We're looking for people with the potential to become exceptional sellers. You'll be articulate, commercially curious, quick to learn, and comfortable starting conversations with people you don't know. You'll ask good questions, take feedback well, and be willing to keep going when the first answer is no. An interest in AI and curiosity about how the federal government buys will give you plenty to get stuck into.

📍 This role is hybrid with the expectation of 3 days per week in our buzzing Midtown NYC office on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

Before we get to the day-to-day, hear from a few future teammate! 📣

⭐ Brianna (BDR) - "Coming from an athletic background, I naturally gravitated toward a competitive work environment in tech sales. At AutogenAI, I get to compete in a rapidly growing market with a winning team and real room to grow!”

⭐ Hannah (Account Executive) - “AutogenAI was my first sales role and I went from BDR to AE in 12 months. Amazing people, a brilliant product, and a team that wins together. If you've got the drive, this is where you accelerate.”

• Track your impact: Measure, reflect on, and share what’s working, and contribute to improving how we do things.

We’re Looking for People Who Are…

• Early career sellers: You have a few months outbound experience – enough to know it motivates you. You’re confident picking up the phone and are looking for the right product, team and culture where your efforts will be rewarded and you’ll want to come to work!

• Strong communicators: Confident, clear, and engaging on the phone and in their words.

• Goal-oriented: Motivated by targets and progress, with genuine resilience.

• Curious and analytical: Eager to understand complex ideas and share informed perspectives.

• Adaptable: Thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where change is constant.

• Collaborative: Work well with others and support a team-first culture.

• Coachable: Take feedback seriously and act on it to improve.

• Creative: Comfortable testing new ideas and helping us stay ahead of the curve.

You’ll Thrive Here If You…

• Are serious about building a career in tech sales

• Are fascinated by AI and want to see its real-world impact on high-stakes work

• Want structured growth, hands-on mentorship, and a clear path forward

• Value autonomy, ownership, and being part of a team that’s building something meaningful

• Align with our values: we obsess about our customers, take ownership, learn fast, raise the bar, and treat each other with trust and respect

Career Progression...

• Your first 6-9 months will be learning our platform, connecting with prospective clients, sitting-in on sales demos, and learning how our product is transforming the proposal space.

• BDRs are truly our engine room – your progress is our progress! With high energy, a can-do attitude and a laser focus on self-development, learning and success your career will flourish here.

How to Apply:

• Along with your resume, please include a short elevator statement - this is your chance to let your personality shine. What draws you to this role, what else are you passionate about, what about AutogenAI attracts you?

Compensation and Benefits:

• Competitive Salary: $60,000 basic salary (depending on experience), plus uncapped commission (~$95,000 OTE)

• Stock Options: Meaningful equity in the company.

• Comprehensive medical/dental/life insurance: Insurance coverage for individuals and families partially paid by the company as well as opportunity to participate in pre-tax health Flexible Spending Account.

Our Principals - Culture in Action

• Raise the Bar – Good enough isn’t enough. We push boundaries, move fast, and believe there’s always a next level.

AutogenAI is a merit-based equal opportunity employer, drug-free workplace, and complies with ADA regulations as applicable.

Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Tokenization team's mission is to bring both public and private equity to be tradable 24/7 on decentralized exchanges (DEXs) across the Robinhood Chain. We work at the intersection of blockchain technology, financial market infrastructure, and modern distributed systems - with a focus on accessibility, security, and scalability. Equity markets have been closed nights and weekends for a century; we're building the infrastructure that changes that.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design and build the core systems that issue, custody, and settle tokenized equities on-chain and keep them in sync with traditional brokerage and ledger systems. You'll lead technically complex projects end to end, make architectural decisions on a foundational Robinhood initiative, and work in a domain where correctness is non-negotiable - the systems you build move real customer assets, continuously, across multiple chains and jurisdictions.

This role are based in either our Menlo Park, Toronto or New York city offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

• Design, build, and operate the backend services that mint, custody, and settle tokenized equities across leading blockchains, with correctness and auditability as hard requirements

• Own large, technically complex projects end to end - design, implementation, rollout, and operating what you ship in a 24/7 system

• Build the connective tissue between traditional market infrastructure (brokerage, ledgers, corporate actions) and on-chain systems, including smart contract integrations, chain indexers, and DEX trade flows

• Partner with product, compliance, legal, and platform teams to turn regulatory constraints into workable system design

• Raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on mentorship

What you bring

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including a track record of delivering large-scale distributed systems in production

• Expertise in backend development with Go, Python, or Java, and deep familiarity with cloud-native architecture (Kafka, Postgres, Kubernetes, or equivalents)

• Strong instincts for correctness-critical systems - idempotency, reconciliation, and reasoning carefully about failure modes when money is at stake

• Demonstrated ownership of ambiguous, cross-functional projects, with the judgment to make tradeoffs and drive alignment

• Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction beyond your own projects

• Working knowledge of blockchain fundamentals - EVM, smart contracts, wallets, on-chain settlement - or a strong appetite to go deep quickly

jobs.title: Algorithm Scientist
jobs.description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are looking for an Algorithm Scientist to join our Future Physiology team. This role focuses on implementing and evaluating novel capabilities in multimodal sensing, combining signals from multiple biosensing pathways to support richer physiological insights. You will work hands-on with experimental sensing systems, analyzing data quality, testing prototype algorithms, and helping build the core signal pipelines for the next generation of health sensing at Oura.

What You Will Do:

• Develop and evaluate algorithms: Implement, refine, and benchmark signal processing and machine learning algorithms for multimodal biosignals (e.g., PPG, motion, temperature, and related physiological modalities).

• Multimodal data integration: Apply practical methods for signal cleaning, noise reduction, feature extraction, and time-series data integration across novel modalities.

• Cross-functional support: Collaborate with hardware, firmware, and software engineering teams to analyze sensor performance and optimize data collection pipelines.

• Hands-on prototyping: Analyze data collected from prototype sensors, evaluation kits, and benchtop setups to assess algorithmic feasibility and signal integrity.

• Physiological exploration: Analyze time-series datasets to discover relationships between physical signal features and underlying physiological states.

• Technical documentation & reporting: Document technical findings, present experimental results, and communicate data-driven insights clearly to project leads and cross-functional teammates.

This is a hybrid role out of our San Francisco office.

What you'll bring

• 2–4+ years of practical experience (including advanced degree research) in biosignal processing, time-series analysis, or sensor fusion.

• Strong expertise in Python and scientific computing libraries (NumPy, SciPy, pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow).

• Solid foundational understanding of human physiological systems and biosensing techniques.

• Practical experience working with noisy, real-world time-series data and designing robust preprocessing pipelines.

• Master’s degree or PhD in Biomedical Engineering, Signal Processing, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to clearly explain complex data, methodologies, and technical results to cross-functional peers.

Nice to have:

• Direct experience working with consumer health products, wearable sensors, or digital health applications.

• Demonstrated ability to work with a fast, experimental pace—rapidly prototyping, testing, iterating, and adapting approaches based on empirical feedback.

• A self-starter attitude with a proactive approach to identifying data anomalies, unblocking technical hurdles, and initiating data-driven research directions.

jobs.title: Head of Commercial, Australia
jobs.description:
About Eucalyptus

We're on a mission to make good health last a lifetime. More than 1 billion people live with obesity worldwide, driving preventable chronic conditions. We're here to build better long-term care.

Eucalyptus is now part of Hims & Hers, the global leader in personalised health and wellness.

Euc is the company behind Juniper, one of the world's largest weight-management programs combining GLP-1 medication with personalised nutrition, movement support, and clinician-led care from prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists, and dietitians. Our published clinical research shows that our combined clinical and behavioural approach helps patients lose significantly more weight during their treatment with Juniper by four times.

Our Growth Story:

• Supporting patients living with obesity across our 5 markets

• Received selective NICE endorsement to provide services to the NHS

• Tailored our offering to thousands of patients in Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan and Canada.

About the Role

The Head of Commercial will be a senior member of the Australian team, reporting to the GM Australia and working closely with leaders across Growth, Product, Operations, Clinical and Finance. You’ll own the commercial view of Hims & Hers Australia, using it to determine where we invest, what we change and how we grow.

This is broader than a traditional finance role. Alongside owning our commercial models, planning and forecasting, you’ll tackle questions spanning new treatments, pricing, retention, partnerships and unit economics. You’ll form clear recommendations, work with teams to put them into practice and track whether they deliver the expected result.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

• Own our commercial performance and reporting. Build and maintain a clear view of performance across revenue, acquisition, retention, gross margin and contribution margin. Identify the underlying drivers, surface risks and opportunities, and ensure the Australian leadership team understands the performance of the business.

• Lead planning and forecasting. Own the Australian business model and lead annual planning, reforecasting and scenario modelling in partnership with Group Finance and FP&A. Help leaders understand the commercial implications of different choices and maintain a realistic view of expected performance.

• Guide our investment decisions. Partner with the GM and Australian leadership team to evaluate and prioritise investment across conditions, products, channels and patient segments. Build the commercial case for major decisions and make clear recommendations about where we should deploy resources.

• Own our unit economics. Develop and maintain a detailed view of customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, payback, retention and margins across products, conditions and patient cohorts. Establish clear economic parameters and help teams understand the levers they can influence.

• Improve growth and profitability. Identify opportunities across pricing, packaging, retention, product mix and margin. Partner with Growth to set acquisition targets, understand marginal returns on marketing investment and allocate spend. Work with functional owners to implement opportunities and track whether the expected value is realised.

• Evaluate new opportunities and partnerships. Assess new treatments, conditions, partnerships and business models, and recommend whether and how we should proceed. Lead negotiations with pharmaceutical companies, suppliers and other strategic partners to improve our economics and build sustainable relationships.

• Own important cross-functional problems. Take responsibility for commercial questions that don’t sit neatly within one team. Work across functions to diagnose the problem, determine what needs to be done and drive it through to resolution.

• Build the commercial function as we grow. Develop the processes, tools, operating rhythms and team required to support a larger and more complex Australian business.

About You

Skills & Experience

• You have at least 6 years of experience in a highly analytical environment. Your experience may come from strategy consulting, investment banking, private equity, strategic finance, corporate strategy, or a commercial role in a high-growth consumer, subscription or technology-enabled business.

• You have a substantial track record of solving ambiguous, high-impact commercial problems and turning recommendations into measurable outcomes.

• You are highly analytical and can build and interrogate financial models, identify the variables that matter and use your analysis to make commercial decisions.

• You have a strong understanding of high-growth consumer economics, including customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, retention, payback and contribution margin.

• You’re comfortable moving between long-term business cases and the operational detail behind a specific performance problem.

• You communicate clearly, turn complex analysis into straightforward recommendations and influence effectively without relying on formal authority.

• Healthcare experience is welcome but not required.

Behaviours & Attitudes

• You take responsibility for business outcomes and stay involved beyond the analysis.

• You form a view and make recommendations rather than simply presenting options.

• You’re curious and investigate why something is happening rather than accepting the first explanation.

• You move quickly through ambiguity while maintaining high standards.

• You’re willing to challenge your assumptions and change your mind when the evidence changes.

• You care about building a large, successful and enduring business.

What’s ahead in Australia?

• Grow with us globally - Get mentorship from leaders across Australia, the UK, Germany, and Japan, collaborate with teams in the Philippines and South Africa, and explore new markets or travel internationally. Recognised on Hatch’s Hotlist as one of Australia’s top employers, we support early-career professionals to become future global leaders.

• Shape your career - Access learning budgets, conferences, certifications, peer shadowing, and a global knowledge-sharing culture.

jobs.title: Marshal
jobs.description:
ABOUT BOLT PHARMACY AND AIOS


BOLT PHARMACY IS OUR MAIN UK PHARMACY BRAND AND PART OF AIOS, THE COMPANY BUILDING THE WORLD'S FIRST FULL-STACK AI DOCTOR. THIS ROLE IS BASED AT BOLT PHARMACY IN BLACKBURN.

AIOS is at $400M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We're the world's fastest growing AI doctor.

We're faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy. We're profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

 1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

 2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

 - Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

 - Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We'll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

 - Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We'll be Europe's largest GLP-1 provider.

 - Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We'll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

 - Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we'll become the world's first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We're a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS https://app.notion.com/p/Working-at-AIOS-5b5c0a584af44de78ac7fb9b2cf8d993?pvs=21




BEING A MARSHAL AT BOLT PHARMACY

We are building a world-class team.

As a Marshal at Bolt Pharmacy (part of AIOS), your fundamental role is to keep our pharmacy floor moving-so patients get the treatment they're counting on.

You'll own your area of the dispensary, keeping packing stations stocked and dispensers supported. You'll anticipate what's needed, respond quickly and tackle bottlenecks before they interrupt the flow. Every minute matters.

You'll bring precision to the pace. From matching medication strengths to orders and protecting the cold chain to spotting stock discrepancies, you'll help keep medicines safe and orders moving. You'll keep your area clear, organised and ready for the next order.

Working alongside Dispensers, fellow Marshals and shift leadership, you'll help Bolt Pharmacy deliver more as we grow. You'll take initiative, flag problems early and step in where the team needs you. Your impact is hands-on, immediate and felt in every order that leaves the building.

Great performance means packers get a response within 3 minutes, packing runs without avoidable interruptions and medicines stay protected. Your area consistently meets our safety and housekeeping standards, and colleagues can count on you every shift.

This is a full-time, on-site role at Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn, UK, working shifts to support warehouse operations.

You'll report directly to our Shift Lead and work closely with our Site Operations Lead, Michal Binkowski https://www.linkedin.com/in/michal-binkowski-352330134/.

You'll work most closely with Bolt Pharmacy's dispensing and operations team.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Keep packing flowing: Patrol your area, respond to packer requests within 3 minutes and replenish medicines and consumables before supplies run out.

 - Get medication control right: Supply only one medication strength and one matching stack of orders per packing table at a time, verifying the match before replenishing.

 - Protect the cold chain: Follow cold-chain procedures and Good Distribution Practice (GDP) requirements, returning temperature-controlled medicines to the fridge immediately when no longer needed.

 - Handle medicines safely: Use designated holding areas, never leave medicines unattended in walkways or packing areas, and immediately quarantine damaged or suspect stock for Shift Lead review.

 - Keep the floor safe and ready: Clear cardboard, keep stations tidy and exits unobstructed, remove immediate hazards and report concerns promptly. Operate equipment only within your training and authorisation.

 - Work as one team: Support fellow Marshals, cover neighbouring areas during breaks and promptly flag stock discrepancies or rotation errors.


NEED TO HAVE

 - Warehouse knowledge: You understand warehouse operations, stock control, Health & Safety and GDP requirements, and put them into practice.

 - Attention to detail: You check medication strengths, order matches and storage conditions carefully. Accuracy is essential.

 - Ownership: You stay organised, anticipate what's needed and manage your area independently as priorities change.

 - Teamwork: You communicate clearly, flag issues early and bring reliable, consistent effort to every shift.

 - A hands-on approach: You can fulfil the role's physical duties, including continuous on-foot activity and routine manual handling.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Regulated operations: You've worked in regulated warehousing, logistics, pharmacy or healthcare.

 - Cold-chain knowledge: You understand how to handle temperature-controlled medicines and protect them throughout the packing process.

 - Warehouse systems: You've used warehouse management tools to track stock and identify discrepancies.

 - Equipment qualifications: You hold forklift or pump truck certification, or baler sign-off. If you don't, we'll provide training.


OUR CULTURAL STANDARDS

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

 1.  Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

 2.  Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

 3.  Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

 4.  If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

 5.  Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

 6.  A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

 7.  Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

 8.  Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

 9.  Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

 10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.


🎯"You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Our compensation package includes equity, giving you the opportunity to share in what we build.

 - Training role: £13 per hour while you complete the required training and sign-off.

 - Qualified role: £15 per hour in total compensation, including equity, once you have completed the required training and are qualified and signed off for the role.


BENEFITS

The stuff below is cool as well.

 - Personal development: A £400 budget for books, courses and coaching to keep building your skills.

 - Personal wellness: A £400 budget for the gym and health apps to support your wellbeing.

 - GLP-1s: Get free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s, if clinically applicable.

 - Health coaching: Access free biweekly health coaching to help you stay healthy.

 - Work coaching: Access free biweekly work coaching to stay sharp and calm.

What are we missing? We're still early, so your ideas can help shape our culture.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Enterprise Commerce – Data (SFCC)
jobs.description:
At Algolia, we’re proud to be a pioneer and market leader in AI Search, empowering 18,000+ businesses to deliver blazing-fast, predictive search and browse experiences at internet scale. Every week, we power over 30 billion search requests — four times more than Microsoft Bing, Yahoo, Baidu, Yandex, and DuckDuckGo combined.

In 2021, we raised $150 million in Series D funding, quadrupling our valuation to $2.25 billion. This strong foundation enables us to keep investing in our market-leading platform and serving incredible customers like Under Armour, PetSmart, Stripe, Gymshark, and Walgreens.

Algolia was built to help users deliver intuitive search and discovery experiences across their websites and applications. We provide APIs and integrations used by thousands of customers around the world. The Enterprise Commerce – Data team focuses on designing and supporting integrations that enable thousands of customers to seamlessly link their commerce platforms with Algolia.

What You Will Do

• Design, develop, and evolve Algolia's Salesforce B2C Commerce (SFCC) integration, with ownership of its architecture, scalability, and long-term technical direction, while contributing to other integrations as needed.

• Own technical work from design through delivery and ongoing improvement.

• Write technical RFCs and contribute to architecture and design decisions.

• Improve the quality, reliability, and maintainability of the integration.

• Investigate and resolve complex integration issues, partnering across Engineering, Product, Support, and customer-facing teams to provide technical solutions within the integration.

• Provide technical input to support roadmap planning, including level-of-effort estimates and identifying opportunities to improve and evolve the integration.

What You Might Bring

• Extensive Salesforce B2C Commerce (SFCC) experience, with deep knowledge of SFRA, cartridges, hooks, jobs, services, and B2C Commerce APIs, including designing and maintaining production SFCC integrations.

• Strong JavaScript skills and experience with requireJs, TypeScript and Node.js.

• Experience integrating commerce platforms with external APIs and services.

• Solid software engineering fundamentals, including automated testing, maintaining existing test suites, debugging, code quality, and maintainable design.

• Ability to own complex technical problems, identify root causes, and implement reliable engineering solutions.

• Ability to communicate technical findings, remediation plans, and trade-offs clearly through technical documentation and RFCs.

• A collaborative approach and willingness to learn, share knowledge, and work across technologies when needed.

• Alignment with Algolia's Core Values: Grit, Trust, Care, Candor, and Humility.

Nice to Have

• Experience with React and headless commerce

• Experience with Adobe Commerce and PHP.

• Experience with Adobe Commerce Cloud Service (ACCS) and Adobe App Builder.

• Experience with other enterprise commerce platforms, including headless or composable commerce.

• Experience building or maintaining publicly distributed cartridges, plugins, SDKs, integrations, or open-source software.

Algolia does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, military status, veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The annual base salary compensation range for this role reflects market pay data within this location. The exact compensation offered for this role may vary depending on specific location and job-related knowledge, technical skills, and experience; and is only one part of our Total Rewards philosophy to compensate and recognize employees for their work.

Base Salary Pay Range

$163,000—$214,000 USD

FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY:

Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual’s impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when.

We have a global presence with offices in Paris, NYC, London, Sydney and Bucharest, however we also offer many of our team members the option to work remotely either as fully remote or hybrid-remote employees. Positions listed as "Remote" are only available for remote work within the specified country. Positions listed within a specific city are only available in that location - depending on the role it may be available with either a hybrid-remote or in-office schedule.

WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO CAN LIVE OUR VALUES:

• GRIT - Problem-solving and perseverance capability in an ever-changing and growing environment.

• TRUST - Willingness to trust our co-workers and to take ownership.

• CANDOR - Ability to receive and give constructive feedback.

• CARE - Genuine care about other team members, our clients and the decisions we make in the company.

• HUMILITY - Aptitude for learning from others, putting ego aside.

We’re looking for talented, passionate people to help build the world’s best search and discovery technology. We value autonomy, diversity, and collaboration. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and supported—regardless of race, age, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, color, veteran status, disability, or socioeconomic background.

IMPORTANT NOTICE FOR CANDIDATES - Recruitment Fraud Notice

We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams targeting job seekers. To help protect yourself, please keep the following in mind:

READY TO APPLY?

jobs.title: Pardavėja (-s) konsultantė (-as) PC Akropolis, Klaipėda, (20-30h)

Kaip pardavėjas (-a)-konsultantas (-ė), atliksite pagrindinį vaidmenį nepriekaištingos klientų patirties kūrime. Atsakomybės:

• Dalinsitės žiniomis apie madą ir prekes su klientais, kad padėtumėte priimti gerai informuotą sprendimą.
• Bendradarbiausite su komanda, kad pateiktumėte geriausią klientų aptarnavimą kiekviename kliento kelionė žingsnyje.
• Užtikrinsite salės ir sandėlio pakankamus prekių kiekius, tvarką ir svetingą atmosferą,
• Padėsite su parduotuvės atidarymo ir uždarymo rutinomis.
• Atstovausite sau ir kompanijai bendraudami su klientais.

KOLEKTYVAS:

Mūsų parduotuvės – kompanijos širdis, nes čia klientai patiria tiesioginį sąlytį su mūsų prekės ženklu. Kaip dalis mūsų dinamiškos komandos, kiekvienas vaidmuo, nuo pardavėjo-konsultanto, skyriaus vadovo, parduotuvės vadovo, vizualistų iki grynųjų pinigų specialisto, prisideda prie įkvepiančios ir jaukios atmosferos kūrimo. Jūs taip pat bendradarbiausite ir su didesne regiono komanda, bendradarbiausite su kitomis parduotuvėmis dalindamiesi įžvalgomis ir pastebėjimais, kad ir toliau vystytumėte kompanijos, parduotuvių ir savo sėkmę. Kartu su komanda turėsite pagrindinį vaidmenį užtikrinant, kad klientai pasitiki savimi ir parodo savo individualumą, pasirinkdami prekes iš naujausių tendencijų ir ilgaamžiškų stilių. Kurdami, prasmę turinčius santykius su klientais mūsų parduotuvėse, mes užtikriname, kad mada yra prieinama ir tvari visiems.

KO TIKIMĖS IŠ JŪSŲ

Ieškome žmogaus, kuris…​

• Turį patirties klientų aptarnavime mados ar panašiose srityse. Patirtis yra privalumas.
• Jaučia aistrą padėti klientams ir jaučią aistra madai – viso kito išmokysime!

Ir žmonių, kurie…​

• Puikiai jaučiasi dirbdami komandoje ir dinamiškoje aplinkoje.
• Yra komunikabilūs, kūrybingi, smalsūs ir pasiruošę dirbti su technologijomis, nori mokytis ir augti.

MES ESAME:​

jobs.title: Head of Fulfillment - Jumia (Full Time)
jobs.description:
About Jumia:

Jumia is a leading pan-African e-commerce platform. Its mission is to improve the quality of everyday life in Africa by leveraging technology to deliver innovative, convenient and affordable online services to customers, while helping businesses grow as they use Jumia's platform to better reach and serve customers.

Jumia is built around a marketplace and supported by a proprietary logistics business [Jumia Logistics] and a digital payment and fintech platform [Jumia Pay]. With over 3,000 employees, Jumia is led by top talented leaders offering a great mix of local and international talents and is backed by very high-profile shareholders. Jumia is committed to creating a sustainable impact in Africa.

In April 2019, Jumia was the first Tech company in Africa to be listed on the New York Stock Exchange.

The Head of Fulfilment is a pivotal leadership role responsible for directing, standardizing, and optimizing Jumia’s core warehousing operations across four key functional units: Inbound, Inventory, Outbound (Order Processing Unit), and Aftersales. Reporting directly to the Chief Supply Chain Officer, this role oversees the entire product lifecycle from initial vendor receipt and stock control to order assembly and post-delivery returns.

By leading dedicated warehouse and aftersales teams, designing operational dashboards, and implementing continuous process improvements, the Head of Fulfilment drives operational efficiency, minimizes stock loss, ensures strict SLA compliance, and optimizes unit costs to support scalable e-commerce growth.

What you will be doing:

• Core Unit & Operations Management End-to-End Operational Oversight: Direct daily warehousing operations across Inbound, Inventory, Outbound, and Aftersales departments to achieve key target KPIs and process efficiency. Order Lifetime Analysis: Monitor order life cycles across the warehouse floor to identify process bottlenecks, eliminate backlogs, and continuously optimize throughput. Process Standardization: Design, implement, and audit standardized processes and SOPs across all warehousing units to elevate overall operational quality. System & Tech Alignment: Liaise closely with technical support and central logistics teams regarding Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) updates, incidents, and system troubleshooting. Out-of-Stock (OOS) Control: Implement proactive inventory protocols to prevent out-of-stock scenarios across Jumia online shops.

• Finance, Stock Control & GovernanceFinancial Accuracy: Ensure all month-end, quarter-end, and year-end warehouse financial processes and audits are executed accurately and on schedule. Stock Health & Shrinkage Prevention: Establish robust stock management processes, cycle count routines, and security measures to ensure zero stock loss, accurate stock counts, and complete investigation of variances. Operational Cost Control: Drive initiatives to reduce the unit cost of fulfillment while increasing the loss-recovered-to-write-off ratio for returned/damaged items.

• SLA & Quality Assurance Performance Reviews: Monitor incident tickets, operational backlogs, and overall SLA health in real time. Quality & Compliance: Oversee strict compliance for inventory storage conditions, quality check (QC) accuracy at inbound, and precise processing of vendor/customer returns. SLA Adherence: Ensure strict adherence to customer and vendor delivery promise times across all network nodes.

• Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management People Leadership: Direct, mentor, and build capability across the warehousing and aftersales leadership teams. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with commercial teams, customer service, and external vendors/3PLs to coordinate hub capacities, volume limits, and handover schedules.

What we are looking for:

• Education & Certifications Degree: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering, or Economics. Certifications: Professional certification in Logistics or Supply Chain Management (e.g., APICS, CSCP, CIPS) is an added advantage.

• Experience Minimum of 6 years of progressive operational leadership in high-volume e-commerce fulfillment, FMCG, or large-scale warehouse management. Functional Mastery: Demonstrated track record directly managing Inbound, Stock/Inventory, Outbound processing, and Reverse Logistics/Aftersales.

• Technical & Analytical Competencies Advanced Data Analytics: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel to analyze operational metrics and build custom reports. Systems Proficiency: High degree of comfort with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), ERP tools, Google Workspace, and operational dashboard reporting tools.

• Leadership & Soft Skills Leadership & Entrepreneurial Drive: High level of autonomy, self-direction, and independent follow-through ability in fast-paced environments. Problem Solving & Coordination: Strong problem-solving skills, stakeholder negotiation, and cross-cultural communication capabilities. E-commerce Understanding: Deep grasp of e-commerce fulfillment best practices, along with seller and customer behavior dynamics.

Deadline for applications: 30-09-2026

Rounds of Interviews: 1. HR Screening; 2. Technical interviews with potential manager

#LI-Onsite

We Offer:

• A unique experience in an entrepreneurial, yet structured environment

• A unique opportunity of having strong impact in building the African e-commerce sector

• The opportunity to become part of a highly professional and dynamic team

• An unparalleled personal and professional growth as our longer-term objective is to train the next generation of leaders

Please ensure to only apply for jobs with Jumia through our official website.

Jumia will never charge you a fee to apply for a job: be wary of websites that claim to help you apply for a Jumia job or that charge a fee to get you a job.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, SMB Sales
jobs.description:
About the Team

The In-Store Sales team at DoorDash is responsible for growing and scaling the SevenRooms platform by empowering operators to take control of their guest relationships. We serve as trusted advisors to restaurants and hospitality groups, helping them solve real business challenges through thoughtful, consultative solutions. Our team takes pride in building strong relationships, identifying operational gaps, and recommending technology that helps operators streamline in-store experiences and deliver exceptional hospitality. As part of DoorDash’s broader sales organization, we play a critical role in driving new business growth while supporting long-term success for our partners.

About the Role

As Senior Manager, Sales – In Store, you will lead a team of ~4 managers who support regional SDR and in-field Account Executives, with full ownership of in-store revenue growth and execution across your region. You will be deeply involved in coaching and developing leaders, setting clear performance expectations, and driving sales execution – from pipeline generation and deal strategy through successful merchant adoption.

You will operate with autonomy in a fast-changing environment – bringing structure to a new and scaling function, contributing to go-to-market and strategic initiatives, supporting product rollouts, and iterating quickly as our in-store offerings and merchant needs evolve.

You will report to the Senior Director of SMB Commerce Platform, who will provide guidance and support as the In-Store sales function continues to scale across North America. This role requires traveling within your region (~2-4 times per quarter) to support your team and merchant partners, with additional time working remotely or from a DoorDash office. In addition, this role will require the ability to travel as needed for in-person collaboration through trainings, offsites, team-building events, and other business related necessity.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Lead a high-impact team: Manage and mentor a team of Sales Managers and their sales representatives focused on in-store product adoption across strategic accounts and regions.

• Drive strategy and execution: Develop, implement, and continuously refine go-to-market strategies for DoorDash’s in-store offerings, ensuring alignment with company goals and merchant needs.

• Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with Product, Strategy & Operations, Sales Development, and Account Management teams to identify opportunities, refine solutions, and optimize customer experiences.

• Enhance team performance: Cultivate a culture of performance, ownership, and inclusivity. Prioritize the development and engagement of your team to support long-term success.

• Innovate and optimize: Identify trends and operational inefficiencies. Design and implement scalable solutions, processes, and tools that increase effectiveness and streamline adoption.

• Stay merchant-obsessed: Leverage direct merchant insights and field feedback to improve offerings and influence product development.

We’re excited about you because…

• You have 6+ years of sales experience, including exceeding performance targets and building successful pipeline strategies.

• You bring 4+ years of people management experience, with a strong record of leading managers and developing high-performing teams.

• You’ve successfully worked in cross-functional environments, aligning various stakeholders toward common goals.

• You are a strategic and analytical thinker, with a data-driven mindset and a passion for solving complex challenges.

• You are a strong communicator who can effectively articulate vision, build consensus, and influence outcomes.

• You are a hands-on leader who isn’t afraid to dive into the details, coach on tactics, and unblock your team.

• You are deeply committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, both in team-building and customer engagement.

Compensation

Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants and sales commission. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

• For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.

• For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

$174,240—$256,240 USD

The total on-target earnings (base + commissions) for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.

$217,800—$320,300 USD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. jobs.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner – Strategic Sales
jobs.description:
HELP BUILD THE COMMERCIAL TEAM SCALING CUTTING-EDGE CONSTRUCTION TECHNOLOGY



At XYZ Reality https://www.xyzreality.com, we’ve created the world’s first engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution for construction. Our product, The Atom, is used on major projects worldwide to help construction teams build more accurately, efficiently and with fewer mistakes.

As a Series B business scaling rapidly across the US and internationally, we’re looking for an experienced Senior Talent Acquisition Partner to play a critical role in building the commercial talent behind our next stage of growth.

We’re looking for someone who understands what exceptional sales talent looks like — and, importantly, knows where to find it.

If you have deep experience hiring high-performing Account Executives and strategic sales professionals, particularly those selling into construction, AEC, Data Centres or adjacent industries, we’d love to hear from you.




THE ROLE

You’ll own recruitment across our growing US commercial organisation, with an initial focus on hiring high-calibre Account Executives and strategic sales talent capable of selling complex technology and services into the construction industry.

This is not a role focused on processing applications. You’ll proactively identify the strongest performers in the market, understand the companies and talent pools we should be targeting, and build relationships with sales professionals who may not be actively looking.

You’ll partner closely with senior commercial leaders, including our CRO and wider leadership team, to understand the profile of successful hires, challenge requirements where needed and translate our growth plans into a focused talent strategy.

You’ll combine hands-on sourcing with commercial insight, using market mapping, competitor intelligence, referrals and targeted outreach to build a strong pipeline of proven sales talent.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - Own end-to-end recruitment for Account Executives, Strategic Sales and wider commercial roles across the US and beyond.

 - Identify and engage proven sales performers from construction, construction technology and relevant adjacent markets.

 - Build detailed market maps across target companies, competitors and high-value talent pools.

 - Proactively headhunt passive candidates rather than relying on inbound applications.

 - Develop a strong understanding of who the top sales performers are, where they sit and what will attract them.

 - Partner with the CRO and senior commercial leaders to define hiring profiles and advise on talent availability, compensation and market dynamics.

 - Challenge assumptions and bring external market insight into hiring decisions.

 - Assess candidates against commercial performance, sales complexity, customer profile and cultural fit.

 - Build proactive pipelines against future commercial growth plans.

 - Deliver an excellent candidate experience from first approach through to offer and close.

 - Use recruitment data and market intelligence to provide clear visibility of pipeline, progress, risks and opportunities.

 - Help strengthen our direct sourcing capability and reduce reliance on external search and recruitment agencies.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Significant experience recruiting senior Account Executives, Strategic Sales, Enterprise Sales or similar commercial talent.

 - A strong track record of hiring high-performing salespeople into high-growth businesses.

 - Experience recruiting sales professionals who sell into the construction industry is highly desirable.

 - Strong understanding of relevant talent markets such as construction technology, AEC software, SaaS, professional services or other complex B2B environments.

 - Demonstrable ability to identify proven sales performers, rather than simply candidates with the right job titles.

 - Exceptional direct sourcing, headhunting and market-mapping capability.

 - Strong commercial judgement and the ability to understand sales models, territories, customer segments and individual performance.

 - Confidence partnering with C-suite and senior commercial stakeholders, providing insight and constructively challenging where appropriate.

 - Experience operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where priorities and hiring requirements can evolve quickly.

 - Strong candidate management and closing skills, particularly with senior passive talent.

 - Based in or within commuting distance of Austin, Texas - Beneficial

Above all, we’re looking for a recruiter who is commercially curious, naturally proactive and genuinely passionate about finding exceptional talent. Someone who wants to understand who the best people in the market are, and then work out how to bring them to XYZ Reality.




WHY JOIN US

 - 🚀 Work at the cutting edge of AR and construction technology

 - 📈 Play a direct role in scaling our US commercial organisation

 - 🌍 Help build teams across a rapidly growing international business

 - 🎯 Own strategically important searches with direct senior leadership exposure

 - 🏠 Hybrid working + flexible hours

 - 🩺 Private medical, including dental & vision

 - 🎄 Extra Christmas shutdown days

 - 🏝️ 15 days PTO + public holidays

Ready to help us find the commercial talent behind our next stage of growth?

We’d love to hear from experienced sales recruiters who know how to find exceptional people in competitive markets and want to have a genuine impact on a growing business.

You can see XYZ Reality and The Atom in action through our YouTube channel and website.

jobs.title: Sr. Digital Product Manager
jobs.description:
“Mineralys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone.  Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor.  Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit https://mineralystx.com. Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn, Twitter and Bluesky”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Reporting to the Director, Omnichannel & Digital Marketing, the Digital Product Manager is a hands-on execution leader responsible for translating brand and omnichannel strategy into tactical digital plans and flawless delivery across HCP and patient channels. This role plans and drives digital and web-oriented projects from ideation through launch, with day-to-day ownership of execution, launch readiness, and deployment coordination. Working closely with leadership, brand teams, developers, agency partners, and other cross-functional stakeholders, the Digital Product Manager ensures alignment on objectives, scope, timeline, cost, and quality. Success in this role requires deep operational expertise across CRM, email, web, field-enabled digital, and paid media executions; fluency in Veeva and Salesforce Marketing Cloud; command of the PRC/MLR review process; and a customer-centric mindset focused on building scalable, reusable solutions in a lean, fast-moving, launch-focused environment.

Principal Responsibilities

Strategy, Planning & Cross-Functional Alignment

• Translate brand and omnichannel strategy into tactical digital plans and drive execution, working closely with leadership, stakeholders, developers, and other cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on objectives and deliverables.

• Plan and oversee digital and web-oriented projects from ideation to completion that are strategically aligned, including securing cross-functional alignment on project scope, benefits, cost, and timeline.

• Manage internal and external timelines across projects, with a clear understanding of timeline impacts and dependencies across tactical development and deployment.

• Maintain integrated digital timelines, trackers, asset inventories, and handoffs across brand, agencies, IT, Analytics, and deployment partners.

• Translate brand and business objectives into actionable digital execution plans, prioritizing work to deliver the greatest value against launch goals.

HCP & Patient Digital Execution

• Lead day-to-day HCP and patient digital tactic execution across web, CRM/email, field-enabled digital, and paid media channels; a broad understanding of the HCP landscape is preferred.

CRM, Email & Field Enablement

• Drive CRM/email asset pull-through, applying best practices across triggers, customer journeys, and dynamic modules.

• Coordinate end-to-end rep-triggered email execution, including content handoff, Veeva configuration, field deployment, testing/QA, versioning, and coordination with field, brand, and agency teams.

• Build, configure, and deploy content within Veeva and Salesforce Marketing Cloud, ensuring assets are set up and delivered to best-practice standards.

Content Operations, PRC & Compliance

• Apply a strong understanding of the PRC process, including routing in Veeva PromoMats, managing version control across assets, and collaborating with the PRC team.

• Maintain a strong understanding of digital platforms and best practices, ensuring execution adheres to regulatory, privacy, and internal governance requirements.

Measurement & Reporting

• Coordinate dashboard inputs and reporting follow-ups, monitor tactic-level performance and delivery, and surface executional issues and optimization opportunities to brand and Analytics partners.

• Partner with Analytics and Research teams to connect execution to outcomes, ensure approved measurement plans and tracking requirements are implemented, and inform ongoing optimization.

Partnership & Collaboration

• Manage agency partners with clear direction, feedback, quality oversight, and accountability for timelines and deliverables.

• Collaborate closely with internal partners, including HCP and Patient brand teams, IT, Patient Support Services, Analytics, and Research teams, to align objectives and deliverables.

Education & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree required

• 5-7+ years of relevant experience in digital marketing, digital product/project management, or omnichannel execution, with pharmaceutical/biotech industry and launch experience strongly preferred.

• Hands-on experience with Veeva (CRM and PromoMats) and Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including CRM/email and rep-triggered email configuration and deployment.

• Strong working knowledge of HCP and patient marketing in a regulated industry, including PRC review, Veeva PromoMats routing, version control, FDA promotional requirements, and privacy laws (e.g., HIPAA).

• Experience with website content management, media trafficking/tagging, QA, launch readiness, and agency/cross-functional execution.

Skills & Attributes

• Strong marketing proficiency, project management, verbal, written and executive communication skills are required along with demonstrated presentation skills.

• Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and timelines without sacrificing quality.

• Comfortable operating with autonomy in a lean, fast-moving, launch-focused environment; self-directed, proactive, and accountable for outcomes.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret digital performance data, customer insights, and competitive intelligence and translate findings into actionable executional recommendations.

US Salary Range:  $130,000-$145,000
