jobs.title: Dispenser
jobs.description:
ABOUT BOLT PHARMACY AND AIOS

Bolt Pharmacy is our main UK pharmacy brand and part of AIOS, the company building the world's first full-stack AI doctor. This role is based at Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn.

AIOS is at $400M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We're the world's fastest growing AI doctor.

We're faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy. We're profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

 1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

 2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

 - Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

 - Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We'll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

 - Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We'll be Europe's largest GLP-1 provider.

 - Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We'll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

 - Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we'll become the world's first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We're a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.




BEING A DISPENSER AT BOLT PHARMACY

We are building a world-class team.

As a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy (part of AIOS), your fundamental role is to turn prescriptions into treatment patients can count on -  safely, accurately and at pace.

You'll be at the heart of our dispensing operation, selecting, labelling and securely packing medicines for patients across the UK. You'll take ownership of your work within your qualified scope, follow dispensing procedures precisely and escalate clinical questions to our pharmacists. Every prescription has a person behind it.

You'll keep quality high as volumes grow. From protecting the cold chain and monitoring storage temperatures to managing stock and checking deliveries, you'll help keep medicines safe and orders moving. You'll report errors and near misses promptly, so we learn quickly and keep improving.

Working alongside pharmacists, fellow dispensers and our stock and customer service teams, you'll help resolve issues before they delay treatment. You'll also support trainee dispensers and spot practical ways to make Bolt Pharmacy's operation more efficient. Your experience will help raise the standard of the whole team.

Great performance means consistently processing 30+ orders per hour while maintaining over 99.5% dispensing accuracy, zero critical errors and full compliance with our procedures. Patients receive the right treatment, colleagues trust your work and we can serve more people with confidence.

This is a full-time, on-site role at Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn, UK, working standard business hours with possible shift patterns.

You'll report directly to our Shift Lead and work closely with our Site Operations Lead, Michal Binkowski https://www.linkedin.com/in/michal-binkowski-352330134/.

You'll work most closely with Bolt Pharmacy's pharmacists, qualified and trainee dispensers, Stock Control and Customer Service, combining dispensing oversight, shared workloads and patient support.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Get every prescription right: Select, label and prepare medicines accurately within your qualified scope, following SOPs and escalating clinical queries to pharmacists.

 - Keep treatment moving: Process and securely pack 30+ orders per hour while maintaining accuracy, safety and compliance.

 - Protect every medicine: Maintain cold-chain controls, monitor fridge and room temperatures, and escalate storage deviations immediately.

 - Take ownership of stock: Check incoming deliveries, maintain correct storage and rotation, and support stock takes so medicines are available when needed.

 - Make quality everyone's business: Record errors, near misses and incidents promptly, keep workstations clean and compliant, follow hygiene and PPE procedures, and suggest practical improvements.

 - Raise the team's standard: Guide trainee dispensers, support colleagues and work with Customer Service to resolve patient queries and order updates.


NEED TO HAVE

 - Dispensing qualification: You hold a valid Buttercups certification or equivalent dispensing qualification.

 - Experience at pace: You've worked in high-volume dispensing and can consistently meet a target of 30+ orders per hour without compromising safety.

 - Attention to detail: You bring exceptional accuracy to medicine selection, labelling and prescription preparation.

 - Ownership within your scope: You organise your workload independently, follow SOPs precisely and know when to involve a pharmacist.

 - Professionalism: You're reliable, punctual and committed to patient safety and regulatory compliance.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Qualified experience: You've spent at least a year working as a qualified dispenser.

 - Online pharmacy: You understand the demands of dispensing and dispatching treatment to patients remotely.

 - Mentoring: You've trained or supported junior colleagues and can explain procedures clearly.

 - Stock management: You bring experience in inventory control, stock rotation and keeping a busy dispensary supplied.

 - Patient support: You've handled healthcare queries with care, clarity and professionalism.

 - Pharmacy standards: You're familiar with GPhC requirements and how they translate into everyday practice.


OUR CULTURAL STANDARDS

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

 1.  Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

 2.  Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

 3.  Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

 4.  If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

 5.  Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

 6.  A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

 7.  Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

 8.  Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

 9.  Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

 10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

🎯 "You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Our compensation package includes equity, giving you the opportunity to share in what we build.

 - Training role: £13 per hour while you complete the required training and sign-off.

 - Qualified role: £15 per hour in total compensation, including equity, once you have completed the required training and are qualified and signed off for the role.


BENEFITS

The stuff below is cool as well.

 - Personal development: A £400 budget for books, courses and coaching to keep building your skills.

 - Personal wellness: A £400 budget for the gym and health apps to support your wellbeing.

 - GLP-1s: Get free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s, if clinically applicable.

 - Health coaching: Access free biweekly health coaching to help you stay healthy.

 - Work coaching: Access free biweekly work coaching to stay sharp and calm.

 - What are we missing? We're still early, so your ideas can help shape our culture.

jobs.title: Residential Program Manager - (RPM)
jobs.description:

Pay Starting at $44,000

Aspire Living & Learning believes it must play an active role in creating a community of employees that is diverse, inclusive and equitable. Our work benefits greatly from the contributions of people of color, people from working class backgrounds, women, LGBTQ people, and individuals with disabilities. jobs.title: Project Interior Designer V
jobs.description:
If you think your skills, experience and aspirations make you a good match for this position, we encourage you to apply. This position may be filled anywhere in the United States.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This senior-level position is a leadership role within our multi-disciplinary team, responsible for guiding and mentoring project teams across multiple interior design projects. The Interior Designer V will demonstrate expertise in furniture planning, specification, procurement coordination, design leadership, storytelling, and strategic impact. This role requires proactive communication, independent conceptualization, and a commitment to quality and standards. The individual will serve as a furniture subject matter expert, collaborate with design leaders and contribute to business development and community engagement.

HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Provide leadership to the client and project team in establishment of the project goals and vision.

• Operates with high autonomy and strategic influence, guiding firm-wide standards, mentoring teams, and setting design direction independently.

• Provide interior design leadership across multiple projects with a focus on furniture planning, building a strong conceptual strategy for the project that is rooted in the client’s vision and aspirations.

• Guides and motivates teams, leads the creative process, and promotes firm strategies, policies, and procedures.

• Expected to conceptualize, set direction for design, with a focus on furniture planning, and oversee production and discipline coordination.

• Lead the interior design approach of the project’s goals through all phases of the project (the Pursuit, Programming and Visioning, Concept Design, Schematic Design, Design Development, Construction Design, Procurement and Construction Administration).

• Evaluate client needs, analyze and effectively document design objectives and spatial requirements.

• Coordinate and delegate project design work and code compliance.

• Collaborate work with other disciplines, including architecture, engineering, strategy, experiential branding and consultants.

• Conduct a review of drawings and support functions in conformance with project time, budget and quality constraints.

• Delegation and oversight of and production of design visualization.

• Collaborate with project leaders to develop project work plans for the interior design components of the project and monitor design staff adherence to schedule.

• Lead client meetings and maintain strong client relationships.

• Implement, follow, maintain, and enforce interior design standards used throughout interior design team in all project aspects/phases.

• Lead the development of and/or oversee documentation for furniture, fixtures, and equipment (FFE) throughout all phases of the interior furniture design work, as required.

• Lead the development of material palettes that communicate stories and support the client’s objectives

• Specification oversight.

• Mentor and guide less experienced interior design staff.

• Actively participate and promote design excellence and firm strategies.

• Collaborate with design leadership and participate in business development opportunities, and industry events

• Consult with furniture manufacturers, dealers, product vendors and industry partners, building strong relationships in the design community.

• Lead and/or participate in marketing activities, including proposal development and interviews.

• Participate in construction administration activities, including site visits, review of submittals and shop drawings, and conducting punch lists. Site visits frequently require a physical walk-through of site.

• Ensure sustainability metrics goals are met for projects.

• Work within project budgets and schedules to meet profitability goals.

• Maintain 80% billable time and 10% marketing time.

• May perform other duties as required.

HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL NEED

• Bachelor or Master's degree in Interior Design, Interior Architecture, or relevant field required.

• A minimum of 10 years of related experience is required.

• Current NCIDQ certification or applicable certification/licensure preferred.

• Ability to provide interior design leadership focusing on furniture across multiple projects.

• Strong experiential design, storytelling and technical skills as well as the knowledge of building and life safety codes required.

• Exceptional presentation, organizational, team building, collaboration and communication skills are a must.

• The ability to build and maintain client relationships is essential.

• Experience leading a high performing team and mentoring staff is required.

• Conceptualization and ability to set direction for furniture planning, furniture palettes, specifications and implementation.

• Application of standards and quality process adherence.

• Production oversight and discipline coordination.

• Critical thinker and highly analytical.

• Must be a fully qualified professional able to perform work with a high degree of self-motivation, autonomy and strategic influence.

• Proficiency with Revit, Enscape, Bluebeam, Microsoft Office, and Adobe Creative Suite required.

• Travel as required.

The salary range for this position is $98,328 to $122,933 annually.  This salary range is the range we believe is the anticipated range of possible base compensation at the timing of the posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the anticipated salary range for the position. Employees may be eligible for discretionary bonuses. We offer a full benefit package including medical, dental and vision coverage and flexible spending account options and voluntary insurances. We have paid time off, flex-time schedules, remote work options and a 401k plan and employee perk programs. For a general overview of our benefits, please visit our careers page at https://www.cannondesign.com/careers/benefits. Actual compensation may vary from posting based on geographic location, work experience, education and/or skill level.

ABOUT OUR FIRM

CannonDesign is a design practice where strategy, experience, architecture, engineering, and social impact converge. We don’t just dream up solutions — we create and bring them to life in ways to solve some of the biggest challenges facing our clients and the society. At the heart of everything we do is Living-Centered Design, a bold commitment to using our talents to not just improve the world but to truly reshape it for the better. It’s more than a philosophy — it’s who we are, and it drives us to make a meaningful, lasting difference every day.

ABOUT WORKING HERE

• We are relentless in our pursuit of client adoration (not simply satisfaction). Consistent delivery of the best service is what we are about.

• We are committed to ensuring our practice provides equal opportunities for all employees, as we strive to connect with communities around us and focus on the future of design. We support equity, diversity, and inclusion efforts that benefit all employees through the leadership of our DEI Council, our Employee Resource Groups which are open to everyone, and other community initiatives.

• We’re about communication and transparency here. If you want to talk to someone about an idea you have, or a challenge that needs addressing, we’re ready for you.

Please note that candidates can only apply to our positions on our company Careers site. It's not uncommon for scammers to create positions that look legitimate on other sites; never enter your information or apply for CannonDesign positions on any platform. Should an issue arise that you feel we should be aware of, please contact us. Please provide your resume and portfolio when applying.

As a condition of employment, all employees are expected to complete mandatory training, including compliance training, within required timeframes and adhere to our internal policies and our Code of Conduct.

CannonDesign is an Equal Opportunity Employer. CannonDesign is committed to maintaining a work environment that is free from any and all forms of unlawful discrimination and harassment. It is therefore the firm’s policy to prohibit discrimination and harassment against any applicant, CannonDesign employee, vendor, contractor, or client on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, genetic information, citizenship status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. It is also CannonDesign’s policy to prohibit any and all forms of retaliation against any individual who has complained of harassing or discriminatory conduct, or participated in a firm or agency investigation into such complaints.

jobs.title: H&M Sales Advisor- Hillsdale Shopping Center
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Sales Advisor, you'll be responsible for providing excellent customer service, welcoming & guiding customers through your store to actively sell our products and providing customers with support & guidance. You'll use your fashion and product knowledge to provide our customers with all the relevant information they need for the best experience. You'll also work on garment refill & care, presentation and contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house, working closely with the rest of your store team to deliver an excellent customer experience.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Provide excellent customer service: welcoming & guiding customers through the store & OMNI experience where available, supporting them with direct customer service
• Willingness to engage and have conversations with customers to provide excellent service
• Guide customers through our fashion trends, stories & products in all areas of the store
• Ability to effectively promote and sell our products to customers
• Actively promote our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during all customer interactions
• Support with commercial or operational actions to reach sales targets with store management team

General Information

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors, and relevant influencers, etc.
• Use your product & fashion knowledge to share relevant information to customers

Team & Development

• Retain and share your service, fashion and store operations knowledge and skills with colleagues
• Follow all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store
• Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
• Participate in relevant available Onboarding, introduction processes & trainings and courses relevant for your role & future development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

• Complete full garment cycle from unpacking and refill to steaming and ensure good garment care
• Operate fitting room and checkout areas according to best practice & processes
• Contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house (including stockrooms)
• Support with garment presentation, execution and maintain attractive merchandise displays, clear trends & stories according to visual & commercial guidelines
• Ensure good stock levels with replenishment routines on sales floor
• Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
• Support with opening and closing of the store
• Following all H&S guidelines and legal requirements applicable to role and responsibilities

Who You Are

• As a Sales Advisor, you'll be passionate about fashion and everything we create in-store.
• Motivated by giving customers a great experience.
• You should also be communicative, creative and curious, motivated, flexible, decisive, and action-oriented.
• You should also enjoy working in a collaborative and dynamic environment.
• You have sales experience working in a dynamic and collaborative environment that you can apply to your role
• Experience working with customer service in fashion, retail or other service-related industries

Why You'll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You'll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you're encouraged to be yourself at work
• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You'll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Job Status: Hourly, Non-Exempt

EEOC Code: SLS

Compensation: Sales Associates Pay Rate $19.25  per hour**

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company's discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence, all diversity dimensions are considered in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

When you take the assessment, we collect your responses and use this information to evaluate your suitability for the role to which you have applied. The answers are saved in your applicant profile. We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. Our applicant tracking system provider has access to this information but is contractually prohibited from using it for any other purpose.

During this process, we may collect information from you through cookies, with your consent. This may include details such as your electronic network activity information (IP address, timestamps, and device identifiers). This information is accessible to our hiring team but is otherwise kept confidential. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Notice.

We retain this information for 3 years in your applicant file and use it as set forth in our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information on how your personal data is processed by us, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Senior Named Account Executive
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

Switzerland

About the Role

We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic Named Account Executive to join our Swiss Sales Team, focused on the German-speaking market. In this senior role, your primary mission is new logo acquisition — identifying, pursuing, and closing net-new strategic enterprise accounts across German-speaking Switzerland — while also driving deep platform adoption and expansion within a defined portfolio of existing accounts. The ideal candidate possesses a sophisticated blend of enterprise sales expertise, executive presence, and genuine technical fluency, enabling them to lead engagements at all levels, from the C-suite to senior technical leaders including CISOs, CTOs, and Heads of Infrastructure.

As a Named Account Executive, you will own your account portfolio end-to-end. You will build multi-year account plans, orchestrate virtual deal teams across Solution Engineers, Deal Desk, Legal, and Product, and position Cloudflare as a critical long-term platform partner for some of Switzerland's most strategic enterprises. You will engage at board and executive level, lead complex multi-stakeholder sales cycles, and consistently exceed new logo and expansion targets. In line with Cloudflare's AI-native culture, you will be expected to leverage AI tools actively in your daily workflow — from prospect research and executive outreach to account planning, meeting preparation, and pipeline management — using them as a genuine force multiplier, not an afterthought.

Responsibilities

• New Logo Acquisition: Drive the identification, pursuit, and closure of net-new strategic enterprise accounts as the primary focus of this role. Build a robust pipeline of high-value prospects through targeted executive outreach, ecosystem engagement, partner channels, and referrals. Consistently bring new logos onto the Cloudflare platform and exceed new business targets each quarter.

• Strategic Account Planning: Develop and execute comprehensive, multi-year account plans for both net-new targets and existing named accounts, with clear prioritisation of new logo opportunities. Maintain a detailed, current view of each account's strategic priorities, buying processes, competitive landscape, and Cloudflare's position within them.

• Executive Relationship Management: Build and sustain long-term, trusted relationships at CISO, CTO, CIO, and board level. Act as a genuine strategic advisor across the full lifecycle of the relationship — bringing proactive insight and a strong point of view, not just responding to RFPs or renewal triggers.

• Complex Sales Cycle Leadership: Lead sophisticated, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales processes across legal, procurement, technical, and executive buying centres simultaneously. Demonstrate a nuanced understanding of enterprise buying behaviour and apply it to drive net-new deals forward with precision and appropriate urgency.

• Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding: Develop a thorough understanding of each prospect's and customer's technology environment — including cloud strategy, security posture, compliance requirements, and AI and ML infrastructure. Map Cloudflare's platform capabilities to these environments through relevant Reference Architectures, driving comprehensive platform adoption in place of point-solution sales.

• Virtual Deal Team Leadership: Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of Customer Engineers, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to manage and close complex, high-value opportunities. Proactively navigate blockers, maintain deal momentum, and ensure a consistently high-quality customer and prospect experience throughout.

• AI-Powered Sales Execution: Leverage AI tools as a deliberate and consistent part of how you sell — applying them to prospect research, personalised executive outreach, account planning, stakeholder mapping, meeting preparation, pipeline analysis, and follow-up. Demonstrate the same AI-native mindset Cloudflare brings to its products in how you manage your own territory and time.

• Digital Transformation & AI Positioning: Serve as a knowledgeable and credible partner to customers navigating digital and AI-driven transformation. Understand how AI adoption is reshaping enterprise infrastructure, compliance, and competitive dynamics — and position Cloudflare's platform capabilities, including AI Gateway, Workers AI, and Zero Trust for AI workloads, as central to your customers' strategy.

• Expert Pipeline & Forecasting: Deliver highly accurate, insight-driven account-level forecasts to sales leadership. Maintain rigorous pipeline management across long and complex enterprise sales cycles, providing clear and honest visibility into deal status, risks, and required actions at all times.

• Advanced Negotiation & Closure: Lead complex contract negotiations with confidence and expertise, constructing compelling outcome-linked value propositions directly tied to each customer's strategic objectives. Drive commercially strong and sustainable outcomes across new logo and expansion opportunities.

• Trusted Advisor & Organisational Contribution: Share knowledge, field intelligence, and best practices openly across the team. Provide constructive guidance to colleagues, contribute to the wider organisation's understanding of the Swiss enterprise market, and serve as a leader who elevates the work of those around them.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• 6+ years of advanced experience selling complex technology solutions in a B2B enterprise model, with a significant track record of consistently exceeding multi-million dollar new logo and quota targets in a named or strategic account model.

• Proven enterprise hunter — a demonstrated track record of opening and closing large, complex net-new accounts at C-suite level, not just managing and growing existing relationships.

• Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security (Zero Trust, SASE, SSE), and Edge Computing technologies, with the ability to engage credibly with senior technical buyers including CISOs, CTOs, and Heads of Infrastructure.

• Proven ability to deeply understand complex customer IT architectures and effectively map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures for successful platform sales.

• Demonstrated success navigating complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles across procurement, legal, technical, and executive buying centres simultaneously.

• Demonstrated use of AI tools in a sales context — prospect research, executive outreach personalisation, account planning, pipeline management, or meeting preparation. You can speak specifically to how AI has made you faster, sharper, or more effective, and you are actively pushing your use of AI further.

• Familiarity with AI transformation trends and their infrastructure and compliance implications, with the ability to position Cloudflare's AI platform capabilities as strategic enablers for enterprise customers.

• Exceptional executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to connect platform capabilities to board-level business outcomes and hold the room with senior technical and business stakeholders.

• Advanced negotiation skills with a track record of closing six-figure and multi-million dollar net-new deals.

• Proficiency in Salesforce CRM; MEDDPICC methodology strongly preferred.

• Experience selling into regulated industries in the Swiss or DACH market — financial services, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or critical infrastructure — is a significant advantage.

• Proficiency in advanced sales and business intelligence platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-Suite, MSFT suite).

• Highly self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and resilient, thriving in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a consistent focus on long-term goals.

• Ability to travel as required to engage with key customers and internal teams.

• Language Skills: German & English

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Digital Natives Account Executive
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

Switzerland

About the Role

We are seeking a commercially sharp and technically curious Digital Natives Account Executive to join our Swiss Sales Team, focused on the German-speaking market. In this high-energy, hunter role, your primary mission is new logo acquisition — finding, engaging, and closing net-new digital-native companies across the region who are not yet working with Cloudflare. Your target universe includes fintechs, SaaS platforms, AI-native startups, developer-led scale-ups, and cloud-first businesses: companies that move fast, make infrastructure decisions at the engineering level, and expect their vendors to keep up. The ideal candidate understands how digital-native companies actually buy — bottom-up product adoption, engineering influence, founder-driven decisions, and rapid procurement — and engages as a credible peer in conversations with CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and technical founders.

As a Digital Natives Account Executive, you will build pipeline through outbound prospecting, community engagement, and ecosystem presence, convert developer-led adoption into commercial new logo wins, and position Cloudflare as the infrastructure partner of choice for the next generation of technology companies. Critically, you will use AI tools as an active and integral part of how you sell — both because your buyers, who are often building AI products themselves, will notice and respect it, and because winning new logos at pace in this segment requires it. In line with Cloudflare's AI-native culture, you are expected to leverage AI tools daily as a genuine force multiplier across your prospecting, pipeline, and preparation — not as an occasional aid.

Responsibilities

• New Logo Acquisition: Drive the identification, pursuit, and closure of net-new digital-native accounts as the primary focus of this role. Build pipeline through outbound prospecting, community engagement, VC and accelerator networks, partner channels, and product-led adoption signals. Consistently bring new customers onto the Cloudflare platform and exceed new logo targets each quarter.

• Outbound & Ecosystem-Led Pipeline Generation: Take full ownership of pipeline creation — through direct outreach, active participation in the startup and tech ecosystem, and engagement with founder and developer communities across DACH. Identify buying signals early and move quickly to engage the right stakeholders at the right moment.

• Developer & Technical Buyer Engagement: Build credible, trusted relationships with technically sophisticated buyers — CTOs, VPs of Engineering, platform leads, and technical founders. Engage with genuine fluency on infrastructure, APIs, developer experience, cloud architecture, and security — translating Cloudflare's capabilities into outcomes that matter to people who build things.

• Product-Led Growth Conversion: Identify accounts where individual or team-level usage of Cloudflare's platform signals a commercial opportunity. Convert that adoption into formalised new logo wins by engaging the right stakeholders with the right narrative at the right time, before a competitor does.

• AI Platform Positioning: Position Cloudflare's AI infrastructure capabilities — AI Gateway, Workers AI, Vectorize, and Zero Trust for AI workloads — to prospects building AI-powered products and services. Understand the real challenges your customers face around securing AI APIs, managing inference at scale, and controlling AI infrastructure costs, and articulate how Cloudflare addresses them in a way that resonates with technical buyers.

• AI-Powered Sales Execution: Leverage AI tools as a deliberate and consistent part of how you prospect and sell — applying them to target account research, personalised outreach at scale, technical meeting preparation, pipeline management, and follow-up drafting. Your buyers are often building AI products; your workflow should reflect the same standard. Demonstrated AI fluency is a genuine expectation of this role, and you will be asked to speak specifically to how you use AI to improve your performance.

• Full-Cycle Sales Management: Run efficient, full-cycle sales processes across a diverse prospect portfolio with varying deal sizes and cycle lengths. Qualify rigorously, engage the right stakeholders, apply appropriate urgency, and close new logo deals with confidence — whether the cycle takes two weeks or six months.

• Compelling Value Creation: Articulate clear, outcome-linked value propositions for Cloudflare's platform, tailored to the specific context and priorities of each prospect. Lead with the "why," communicating the full picture to both technical and commercial stakeholders at every stage of the sales cycle.

• Post-Close Positioning: Ensure newly closed customers are set up for success on the Cloudflare platform and positioned for long-term growth. Identify early expansion signals and hand off cleanly — then focus on the next new logo.

• Pipeline Management & Forecasting: Maintain a healthy, accurate new logo pipeline and deliver reliable, insight-driven forecast calls to sales leadership. Use AI-powered pipeline intelligence tools to keep your view of the business current, honest, and actionable.

• Market Insight & Team Contribution: Share field intelligence from the digital-native ecosystem openly with the wider team. Contribute to Cloudflare's understanding of how this segment builds, buys, and scales — and help the organisation stay relevant and competitive in a fast-moving market.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• 3–5 years of experience in B2B technology sales, with a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding new logo and quota targets, ideally selling to digital-native, developer-led, startup, or scale-up companies.

• Proven hunter mentality in a digital-native or startup context — you know how to find the right companies, get in front of the right people, and close before the window closes. You build your own pipeline and do not wait for inbound.

• Strong understanding of how digital-native companies buy — product-led growth, bottom-up adoption, engineering influence, founder decision-making, and fast-moving procurement cycles. You engage as a peer, not a vendor.

• Comfort engaging with technical buyers — CTOs, VPs of Engineering, platform leads, and founders — on infrastructure, APIs, developer tooling, cloud architecture, and security. You do not need to write code, but you think like someone who does.

• Demonstrated use of AI tools in a sales context — outreach drafting, account research, meeting preparation, pipeline management. This is a genuine requirement; be prepared to discuss specifically which tools you use and how they improve the quality and pace of your new business activity.

• Familiarity with AI infrastructure concepts — inference APIs, vector databases, LLM cost management, AI security — and the ability to engage credibly with customers who are building AI-powered products and services.

• Experience in the startup or VC ecosystem is a strong advantage — you understand how these companies are funded, how they make decisions, and what they genuinely care about.

• Knowledge of Cloudflare's developer platform (Workers, R2, Pages, AI Gateway) or competitive equivalents (Fastly, AWS CloudFront, Akamai, Zscaler) is highly advantageous.

• Proficiency in Salesforce or equivalent CRM; familiarity with AI-powered sales tools (intelligent CRM enrichment, AI writing assistants, automated account research platforms).

• Highly self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and technically curious — you are genuinely interested in what your prospects are building and how Cloudflare fits into it.

• Strong coaching and knowledge-sharing instincts, with a passion for contributing to the team's collective intelligence and go-to-market effectiveness.

• Ability to travel within the DACH region and to industry events as required.

• Language Skills: German & English

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Prodajni savjetnik Kcentar Sub City
jobs.description:
ŠTO ĆEŠ RADITI?

Kao prodajni savjetnik, imat ćeš ključnu ulogu u stvaranju izvanrednog iskustva kupovine našim kupcima. Dočekivat ćeš kupce, usmjeravati ih kroz trgovinu, te pokazujući naše proizvode pomagat ćeš im u pronalasku onoga što traže. Prateći naše vrijednosti, pridonosit ćeš osobnom uspjehu, ali i uspjehu kompanije.

Također ćeš:

• Dijeliti svoje znanje o modi i proizvodima, kako bi sa što više informacija pomogao/la kupcima pri donošenju odluke.
• Surađivati sa svojim timom, kako biste pružili iznimnu uslugu kupcu na svakom koraku.
• Brinuti da su prodajni prostor, kao i pozadinske prostorije, dobro opskrbljeni zalihama, organizirani i privlačni.
• Pružati podršku prilikom otvaranja i zatvaranja trgovine.
• Pozitivno predstavljati sebe i brend tijekom svake interakcije s kupcima.

S KIM ĆEŠ RADITI?

Naše trgovine su srce naše kompanije, u kojima se kupci direktno susreću s našim brendom. Kao dio dinamičnog tima u trgovini, svaka uloga – od prodajnih savjetnika, voditelja odjela, voditelja trgovine i vizualnih dekoratera, do glavnog blagajnika – doprinosi stvaranju inspirativnog i gostoljubivog okruženja. Također, surađivat ćeš s timom sa šireg područja, kao i između trgovina, kako biste podijelili iskustva i zajedno postigli uspjeh. Zajedno sa svojim timom, imat ćeš ključnu ulogu u pružanju usluga kupcima kako bi se osjećali samouvjereno te izrazili svoju individualnost uz najnovije trendove i beskrajne stilske mogućnosti. Izgradnjom značajnih veza s kupcima u našim trgovinama, modu činimo dostupnom i održivom za sve.

TKO SI?

• Tražimo ljude s/sa...​
• Iskustvom usluživanja kupaca na području mode, maloprodaji ili sličnim područjima, što će se smatrati prednošću.
• Strašću za pomaganjem kupcima te interesom za modu ili maloprodaju –rado ćemo te naučiti svemu ostalom!

I ljude koji (su)...​

• Uživaju u timskom i dinamičnom okruženju.
• Komunikativni, kreativni i zainteresirani za rad s tehnologijom u trgovini.
• Posjeduju snažnu želju za učenjem i daljnjim razvojem.
• Fleksibilni i orijentiran na aktivnosti.

TKO SMO?

H&M Group je globalna kompanija snažnih modnih brendova i pothvata. Cilj nam je dokazati kako ne postoji kompromis između iznimnog dizajna, pristupačnih cijena i održivih rješenja. Želimo modu svima učiniti dostupnom, a naši kupci su u središtu svake naše odluke koju donosimo.

Čine nas tisuće strastvenih i talentiranih kolega, ujedinjenih zajedničkom kulturom te vrijednostima. Zajedno želimo iskoristiti svoju snagu, svoje postignuće i znanje kako bismo usmjerili modnu industriju prema inkluzivnijoj i održivijoj budućnosti.

ZAŠTO ĆEŠ VOLJETI RADITI OVDJE?

U H&M Grupi, ponosni smo na to što smo energična i gostoljubiva kompanija. Našim zaposlenicima nudimo atraktivne pogodnosti s opsežnim mogućnostima razvoja diljem svijeta.

• 10% popusta za djelatnike na sve naše H&M Group robne marke, kako u trgovinama tako i online
• H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Više o programu saznaj ovdje.​
• Privatno zdravstveno dopunsko i dodatno osiguranje
• Nagrada za dugogodišnji rad za 10, 15 & 20 godina
• Naknada za topli obrok
• Nagrada za umirovljenje
• Dar za vjenčanje
• Program preporuke

PRIDRUŽI NAM SE!

Naša jedinstvenost proizlazi iz kombinacije mnogih faktora– naše inkluzivne i suradničke kulture, naših snažnih vrijednosti i prilika za rast no ponajviše naših ljudi koji nas čine onim što jesmo.​

Zajedno s nama napravi sljedeći korak u svojoj karijeri. Putovanje počinje ovdje.​

* Proces selekcije kandidata:

Radi efikasnog upravljanja s velikim brojem prijava za ulogu prodajnog savjetnika, koristimo online regrutacijsku metodu procjene koja se temelji na vještinama u nekim od naših trgovina. Morat ćeš ih ispuniti kao dio postupka prijave i provjere. Tvoji odgovori bit će ocjenjeni alatom za procjenu koji primjenjuje unaprijed definirane kriterije koje je postavila H&M Grupa.

Nakon dovršetka procjene imat ćeš priliku podijeliti povratne informacije i postaviti pitanja. Ako naiđeš na bilo kakve poteškoće ili preferiraš alternativnu metodu procjene, obrati se na recruitment_support@hm.com. Odabir alternativne metode neće utjecati na tvoju prijavu.

Više informacija o tome kako obrađujemo tvoje osobne podatke, pronađi u našoj Politici privatnosti.

** Predani smo procesu zapošljavanja koji je pošten, pravedan i temelji se na kompetencijama. Stoga te molimo da svojoj prijavi ne prilažeš motivacijsko pismo.​

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Looma Background

Looma is an in-store digital media platform focused on storytelling, education, and recommendations. Their network of in-store screens helps retailers better modernize and monetize their stores, while enabling brands to tell their story directly at the point of decision. All content that airs on Looma’s network is produced or edited by Relay™, their global network of independent filmmakers, editors, and other creators who specialize in point-of-decision content.

Position Summary

Looma is seeking a Senior or Staff Software Engineer to help turn Looma’s Marketplace product into indispensable software for advertisers and retailers. We are open to leveling this role based on experience, demonstrated scope, and expected impact. You will join a small product team and take ambiguous business problems from discovery through production, working backend-first while contributing across the web stack. This role is for a product-minded builder who moves quickly with little hand-holding, uses AI coding agents effectively, and raises the engineering bar without sacrificing speed. You will help evolve a conventional API-and-database backend toward more scalable async workflows, queues, concurrency, intelligent caching, and clearer service boundaries—without prematurely forcing a microservices architecture. Our current stack includes GCP, Go services, BigQuery, Postgres, Redis, and Angular; experience with every tool is not required, and strong engineers should be able to learn quickly.

The responsibilities for this role can be split into three primary categories:

• Marketplace product delivery: 55%

• Engineering quality and architecture: 25%

• Integrations, data, internal tooling, and emerging needs: 20%

Marketplace product delivery (55%)

• Own and ship Looma Marketplace features end-to-end, translating advertiser, retailer, and internal business needs into useful production software.

• Work backend-first across Go services, GCP, Postgres, Redis, and BigQuery while contributing comfortably to the Angular frontend when needed.

• Partner closely with a Product Manager, Product Designer, and long-tenured backend contractor to turn ambiguity into clear decisions and shipped software.

• Move quickly, learn from production, and correct course without losing sight of craftsmanship or the people using the product. Success means increasing the team’s rate of reliably shipping high-quality software for stakeholders.

Engineering quality and architecture (25%)

• Evolve the backend beyond a conventional API-and-database architecture with asynchronous workflows, queues, concurrency, intelligent caching, and clearer service boundaries.

• Improve branch protections, branch naming, CI/CD consistency, automated integration testing, observability, and system-performance dashboards.

• Make pragmatic code-review and remediation decisions: rewrite to demonstrate a better path, coach, or establish reusable standards and automation.

• Keep velocity high while paying down the technical debt that most constrains delivery and reliability.

Integrations, data, internal tooling, and emerging needs (20%)

• Own integrations, data pipelines, infrastructure, and internal tooling that support Marketplace and adjacent business needs.

• Debug cross-system failures and build pragmatic tooling or automation that makes the team faster and more dependable.

• Apply AI-assisted engineering workflows with clear plans, review gates, testing, and other verification mechanisms.

• Contribute across repositories and problem domains when a business priority needs engineering leverage.

Attributes

• You have independently built and shipped a meaningful production software product in a small, ambiguous environment.

• You have materially raised the engineering quality of an existing production codebase while continuing to ship features.

• You bring high ownership and bias to action, strong product judgment and user empathy, technical curiosity, humility, and a willingness to speak up.

• You are deeply AI-native: you routinely delegate implementation to coding agents and build verification loops that produce sound outcomes.

• You make pragmatic speed-versus-quality calls, raising standards without using perfection as a reason to stop shipping.

Structure & Compensation

Looma will provide a competitive compensation package consisting of base salary and stock options. All Looma compensation packages include some cash / equity flexibility (i.e. you can opt for more equity and less cash or vice-versa).

Benefits

• Employee coverage for health, dental, and vision (gold plan)

• Unlimited PTO (3-week minimum)

• Flexible office setting (office, flex, or WFH, with associated stipends)

• Craftsmanship stipend

• Paid parental leave

• 401(k) plan

Our Values

At Looma, we strive to be and/or create work that is:

• For You | Generous, generative, humble, in your corner

• Incisive | Pragmatic, wise, perceptive, insightful

• Beautiful & Clear | Polished, elegant, detailed, conveys a sense of craftsmanship

• Undaunted | Tenacious, courageous, indomitable, “impenetrable ray of sun”

• Dependable | Trustworthy, reliable, nothing slips through the cracks

Diversity & Nondiscrimination

Looma is committed to promoting diversity both in our workplace and through the stories we tell. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability status, age, marital status, protected veteran status, class or caste status, or any other protected class. Our global nondiscrimination policy covers these protected classes in every market in which we do business.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description:
About Us

In 2019, the founders were working as engineers solving complex cross-domain problems within government organisations.

TwinStream was formed to bring together their collective expertise and experience into a single business, focused on delivering technical excellence and high-quality service to clients.

Since then, the company has grown to over 100 team members across the UK, with colleagues working both on-site with clients, hybrid and remotely from home.

Details:

Salary: £90,000 - £110,000 DOE

Location: Fully remote

Eligibility Requirements: Due to the nature of the work, the successful candidate must be UK-based and eligible for DV clearance.

About the role

We are looking for a Head of Product to help shape the direction and continued evolution of TwinStream’s products.

You will bring together customer needs, business opportunities, technical insight and delivery experience to create a clear, coherent product direction. Working across engineering, architecture, delivery, platform, service and commercial teams, you will ensure that product decisions deliver meaningful outcomes while strengthening the long-term value, usability and sustainability of our products.

This is not simply a backlog-management role. You will be responsible for understanding the problems that matter, defining the outcomes we need to achieve and helping teams make informed decisions about where to invest.

You will champion reusable, configurable product capabilities over unnecessary customer-specific solutions and help make our products progressively easier to understand, adopt, deploy, operate, support and extend.

Responsibilities

Product vision and strategy:

• Own and communicate a clear product vision, strategy and roadmap.

• Translate customer, user, commercial and technical insight into prioritised product outcomes.

• Define clear product principles and guardrails to support consistent decision-making.

• Maintain awareness of relevant market, technology and competitor developments.

• Identify opportunities to strengthen and differentiate TwinStream’s product proposition.

Customer and market understanding:

• Develop a strong understanding of our customers, users, prospects & operational environments.

• Work with customers and internal stakeholders to understand underlying problems rather than accepting proposed solutions at face value.

• Identify recurring customer needs that could become reusable core product capability.

• Support commercial & business-development activity with clear product positioning and roadmap context.

• Maintain USP in Cross Domain space.

• Maintain SWOT analysis of the product.

Prioritisation and roadmap management:

• Maintain an outcome-focused roadmap that provides clarity without constraining delivery teams.

• Ensure the roadmap balances customer commitments, future opportunities, security, product evergreening, technical debt, operational efficiency and risk mitigation against market disruption.

• Prioritise investment based on customer value, strategic alignment, commercial opportunity, risk and delivery effort.

• Make transparent trade-offs between customer-specific delivery, core product investment, platform improvement and component evolution.

• Ensure priorities, dependencies, assumptions and decisions are visible and understood.

• Review roadmap progress regularly and adapt it as evidence, risks and priorities change.

Supporting delivery:

• Work closely with Product Oversight, delivery and engineering teams to provide clarity on the problem, intended outcome and product context.

• With the Product Oversight team, help delivery teams determine whether requirements should become core product capability, configurable variation or customer-specific delivery.

• Support shaping of initiatives, epics and features without prescribing detailed technical solutions.

• Provide timely product decisions and remove ambiguity that could delay delivery.

• Encourage experimentation, iterative delivery and early validation.

• Ensure completed capabilities achieve the intended customer and product outcomes.

Product coherence and sustainability:

• Protect the overall integrity and coherence of the product across components, customers and implementations.

• Reduce duplication and fragmentation by promoting common patterns, reusable capabilities and standard approaches.

• Ensure product decisions consider security, maintainability, usability, supportability, observability and operational cost.

• Champion automation, self-service and repeatable deployment and configuration patterns.

• Make product maintenance, lifecycle management and technical sustainability visible within prioritisation decisions.

• Identify repeated delivery or operational pain points and ensure they are considered for simplification, standardisation or Productisation.

Stakeholder engagement:

• Build trusted relationships across customers, engineering, architecture, delivery, platform engineering, service management and business development.

• Communicate product direction, priorities and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Facilitate constructive discussions where customer demand, delivery constraints and strategic priorities compete.

• Provide leadership with clear visibility of product progress, risks, opportunities and decisions.

• Create alignment without relying on hierarchy or excessive governance.

What we’re looking for

You will be comfortable working in a technically complex environment and able to move between strategic thinking and practical delivery.

You will have:

• Experience working as a Product Manager, Product Owner or comparable product leadership role.

• Experience within the cyber security domain, ideally with exposure to cross-domain environments.

• Experience developing product strategies, roadmaps and prioritisation approaches.

• Experience managing platform, infrastructure or technically complex software products.

• A strong understanding of outcome-focused and user-centred product management.

• The ability to understand complex customer and operational problems.

• Experience turning customer-specific requirements into reusable product capabilities.

• An understanding of product lifecycle management, technical debt and software evergreening.

• Confidence working with software engineering, architecture and delivery teams.

• The ability to make balanced decisions when evidence is incomplete or priorities conflict.

• Strong stakeholder-management, facilitation and communication skills.

• Experience translating between customer, commercial and technical perspectives.

• A collaborative approach enabling teams to make good decisions rather than directing all detail.

• The ability to communicate difficult prioritisation decisions clearly and constructively.

It would be useful if you also have

• Experience with enterprise, government, defence or other highly regulated environments.

• An understanding of secure software delivery, DevSecOps, cloud platforms or service operations.

• Familiarity with product discovery, service design or user-research techniques.

• Experience using evidence, metrics and feedback to assess product performance.

• Experience working across multiple delivery teams or product components.

What You’ll Get

• Competitive salary and benefits package

• 28 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, with the option to buy or sell an additional week

• Annual bonus

• Income protection covering you for up to 5 years

• 8% non-contributory pension

• Private healthcare and life insurance

• Enhanced parental leave

• Flexible working

• Opportunities for learning, development, and career progression

• Supportive and inclusive team environment

• The chance to work on meaningful projects

Diversity & Inclusion

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities.

If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know. We’re here to support you

Further Information:

Due to the nature of the work and the sectors we support, any offer of employment will be subject to the successful completion of the relevant security screening and clearance process.

This role requires eligibility for [BPSS / SC / DV] clearance. As part of the vetting process, candidates must meet the UK Government's residency and right-to-work requirements associated with the required level of clearance.

jobs.title: MENAXHER DEPARTAMENTI - Prishtina
jobs.description:
ÇFARË DO TË BËSH​

Si menaxher departamenti, do të jesh lideri që mbështet dhe inkurajon të gjithë ekipin tënd. Duke nxitur një kulturë gjithëpërfshirëse që promovon bashkëpunimin dhe një frymë ndërmarrësie, do të krijosh një mjedis ku të gjithë mund të lulëzojnë. Duke vepruar në përputhje me vlerat tona, do të kontribuosh si në suksesin tënd ashtu edhe në suksesin e kompanisë.

Do të:

• Drejtosh ekipin tënd për të ofruar një përvojë të jashtëzakonshme për klientin duke siguruar standarde të shkëlqyera funksionale dhe vizuale, ndërkohë që në mënyrë aktive promovon dhe shet produktet tona.

• Marrësh përgjegjësinë për pikat e forta të butikut dhe departamentit tënd, analizosh performancën e shitjeve, identifikosh mundësitë komerciale, vendosesh qëllime dhe krijosh plane për të optimizuar rezultatet, fitimet dhe nivelet e stokut

• Menaxhosh planifikimin e ekipit, oraret dhe sigurosh rutinat e hapjes dhe mbylljes pa probleme.

• Rekrutosh, inkorporosh dhe zhvillosh ekipin tënd duke nxitur një kulturë gjithëpërfshirëse dhe bashkëpunuese që promovon rritjen dhe inovacionin.

• Qëndrosh i përditësuar mbi tendencat e modës, preferencat e klientëve dhe konkurrentët për të mbajtur një avantazh konkurrues.

• Përfaqësosh pozitivisht veten dhe markën gjatë të gjitha ndërveprimeve me klientët.

​

ME KË DO TË PUNOSH​

Butikët tanë janë zemra e kompanisë sonë, ku klientët e përjetojnë markën tonë nga dora e parë. Si pjesë e ekipit dinamik të butikut, çdo rol—nga këshilltarët e shitjeve, menaxherët e departamenteve, menaxherët e butikëve dhe merçandajzerët vizual deri te Cash Office Responsible—kontribuon në krijimin e një mjedisi frymëzues dhe mikpritës. Gjithashtu do të lidhesh me ekipin e zonës më të gjerë, duke bashkëpunuar me butikë për të ndarë njohuri dhe për të nxitur suksesin së bashku. Krahas ekipit tënd, do të luash një rol jetësor për të ndihmuar klientët të ndihen të sigurt dhe të shprehin individualitetin e tyre me trendët më të fundit dhe stilet e përjetshme. Duke ndërtuar lidhje domethënëse me klientët në butikët tanë, ne e bëjmë modën të qasshme dhe të qëndrueshme për të gjithë.

​

KUSH JE TI​

Ne po kërkojmë persona me…​

• Përvojë në menaxhimin dhe operacionet e shitjes me pakicë.

• Ekspertizë në planifikim, analizë dhe përcjellje të shitjeve, duke përdorur mjete dhe raportime të përqendruara ndaj klientit.

Dhe persona…​

• Udhëheqës të fortë dhe të sigurt që frymëzojnë, trajnojnë dhe zhvillojnë ekipet e tyre duke ilustruar vlerat dhe kulturën e kompanisë.

• Lulëzojnë në mjedise bashkëpunuese, dinamike, me një mentalitet të fokusuar në zgjidhje.

• Të motivuar për të krijuar përvoja të shkëlqyera për klientët gjatë promovimit dhe shitjes së produkteve tona.

• Kanë interes të madh për tendencat e modës, komercialitetin dhe njohuritë e konkurrentëve për të nxitur shitjet.

• Komunikues efektiv, kreativ dhe kureshtar.

• Fleksibil, analitik dhe të orientuar drejt arritjeve, me aftësi për të menaxhuar statistikat dhe për të punuar me numra

​

KUSH JEMI NE​

H&M Group është një kompani globale e markave dhe ndërmarrjeve të fuqishme të modës. Qëllimi ynë është të vërtetojmë se nuk ka kompromis ndërmjet dizajnit të jashtëzakonshëm, çmimeve të përballueshme dhe zgjidhjeve të qëndrueshme. Ne duam të çlirojmë modën për shumë njerëz dhe klientët tanë janë në qendër të çdo vendimi që marrim.​

​

Ne përbëhemi nga mijëra kolegë të pasionuar dhe të talentuar të bashkuar nga kultura dhe vlerat tona të përbashkëta. Së bashku, ne duam të përdorim fuqinë tonë, madhësinë tonë dhe njohuritë tona për të shtyrë industrinë e modës drejt një të ardhmeje më gjithëpërfshirëse dhe të qëndrueshme. ​

​

PSE DO TË JU PËLQEJË TË PUNONI KËTU ​

Në H&M Group jemi krenarë që jemi një kompani e gjallë dhe mikpritëse. Ne u ofrojmë punëtorëve tanë përfitime tërheqëse me mundësi të gjera zhvillimi në mbarë globin. ​

• 25% zbritje për stafin në të gjitha markat tona të H&M Group, si në butikë ashtu edhe në internet

• H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Më shumë rreth programit mund të mësosh këtu.

• Sigurim Shëndetësor Privat

• Shpërblim për Shërbimin e Gjatë

• Pushim i atësisë

• Shpërblim për pensionim

• Kartelë Dhurate për Foshnje

• Bonus për referimin një mik

BASHKOHU ME NE​

E veçanta jonë buron nga një kombinim i shumë gjërave – kultura jonë gjithëpërfshirëse dhe bashkëpunuese, vlerat tona të forta dhe mundësitë për rritje. Por mbi të gjitha, janë njerëzit tanë ata që na bëjnë ata që jemi.​

Kjo është një pozitë me orar të plotë dhe e përhershme, në Prishtina, Kosovo.

Apliko duke dërguar CV tënde më së voni deri më 14.09.2026. Për shkak të politikave të të dhënave, ne pranojmë aplikime vetëm përmes faqes së karrierës.

Hidhe hapin tjetër në karrierën tënde së bashku me ne. Udhëtimi fillon këtu.​

*Ne jemi të përkushtuar ndaj një procesi rekrutimi që është i drejtë, i barabartë dhe i bazuar në kompetenca. Prandaj, ju lusim të mos bashkëngjitni letër motivuese në aplikacionin tuaj.
