jobs.title: Senior Manager, Fund Accounting
jobs.description:
As a Senior Fund Accounting Manager, you will play a pivotal role in delivering high-quality accounting and financial reporting services to one of our key fund clients.

Responsible for ensuring the accurate and timely production of financial statements, investor reporting, Net Asset Value calculations, regulatory reporting and ad-hoc calculations you will work closely with administration teams, senior management, clients, auditors, and regulators to maintain the highest standards of service delivery and compliance.

The role requires strong technical fund accounting expertise, excellent client relationship skills, and the ability to lead by example in fostering a collaborative, client-focused culture. You will also contribute to continuous process improvement initiatives, support regulatory and compliance requirements, and help drive operational excellence while embodying the organisation's values of being Authentic, Bold, and Collaborative

What You’ll Do

• You will provide technical leadership and risk oversight, supporting complex client structures and transactions, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, and embedding strong risk management practices
• You will build and maintain strategic partnerships with clients and related stakeholders and support with client growth
• You will help lead the team in producing a high level of quality internal and external client service, including the accurate and timely provision of financial accounting services
• You will ensure that the team are following and complying with the company’s policies and procedures and, in case of non-compliance, escalate this in a timely manner
• You will lead and inspire high-performing teams by fostering a culture of excellence, innovation, and continuous learning

What we offer

• Base Salary: Competitive salary based on role, experience, and market standards
• Annual Bonus: Discretionary bonus linked to individual, team, and company performance
• Referral Rewards: Bonus for successful employee referrals
• Pension: 6% non-contributory employer pension scheme
• Insurance Benefits: Medical, dental, life assurance, and income protection coverage
• Health & Wellbeing: Cash plan, counselling support, eye care, and sick pay
• Leave & Flexibility: 25–30 days leave, hybrid working, flexible work, and nimble days
• Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption leave support
• Learning & Development: Professional qualification and career development support
• Additional Perks: Recognition programs, social events, volunteering, and long service awards

• You hold a relevant professional qualification (ACCA/FCCA/CA(SA) or equivalent) with extensive industry experience in fund services or a related field
• You demonstrate strong technical knowledge of fund administration, applicable laws, regulatory requirements, taxation, and best practices across relevant jurisdictions
• You exhibit excellent analytical, numeracy, and IT skills, with the ability to interpret complex fund and legal documentation accurately and with attention to detail
• You communicate effectively and collaborate well with colleagues, showing strong relationship management skills, high self-awareness, and a commitment to continuous development
• You show resilience and integrity in a fast-paced environment, with the ability to manage workloads, meet deadlines, support team members through change, and maintain a strong risk-aware mindset

Our commitment to you and the environment

Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.

There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.

Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 6,500+ employees - from 94 nationalities, across 24 countries - to each achieve their potential.  Through IQ-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.

We’re committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients’ sustainability and success lead to our sustainability and success. We’re emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

jobs.title: Prodajni savjetnik, Max City
jobs.description:
ŠTO ĆEŠ RADITI?

Kao prodajni savjetnik, imat ćeš ključnu ulogu u stvaranju izvanrednog iskustva kupovine našim kupcima. Dočekivat ćeš kupce, usmjeravati ih kroz trgovinu, te pokazujući naše proizvode pomagat ćeš im u pronalasku onoga što traže. Prateći naše vrijednosti, pridonosit ćeš osobnom uspjehu, ali i uspjehu kompanije.

Također ćeš:

• Dijeliti svoje znanje o modi i proizvodima, kako bi sa što više informacija pomogao/la kupcima pri donošenju odluke.
• Surađivati sa svojim timom, kako biste pružili iznimnu uslugu kupcu na svakom koraku.
• Brinuti da su prodajni prostor, kao i pozadinske prostorije, dobro opskrbljeni zalihama, organizirani i privlačni.
• Pružati podršku prilikom otvaranja i zatvaranja trgovine.
• Pozitivno predstavljati sebe i brend tijekom svake interakcije s kupcima.

S KIM ĆEŠ RADITI?

Naše trgovine su srce naše kompanije, u kojima se kupci direktno susreću s našim brendom. Kao dio dinamičnog tima u trgovini, svaka uloga – od prodajnih savjetnika, voditelja odjela, voditelja trgovine i vizualnih dekoratera, do glavnog blagajnika – doprinosi stvaranju inspirativnog i gostoljubivog okruženja. Također, surađivat ćeš s timom sa šireg područja, kao i između trgovina, kako biste podijelili iskustva i zajedno postigli uspjeh. Zajedno sa svojim timom, imat ćeš ključnu ulogu u pružanju usluga kupcima kako bi se osjećali samouvjereno te izrazili svoju individualnost uz najnovije trendove i beskrajne stilske mogućnosti. Izgradnjom značajnih veza s kupcima u našim trgovinama, modu činimo dostupnom i održivom za sve.

TKO SI?

• Tražimo ljude s/sa...​
• Iskustvom usluživanja kupaca na području mode, maloprodaji ili sličnim područjima, što će se smatrati prednošću.
• Strašću za pomaganjem kupcima te interesom za modu ili maloprodaju –rado ćemo te naučiti svemu ostalom!

I ljude koji (su)...​

• Uživaju u timskom i dinamičnom okruženju.
• Komunikativni, kreativni i zainteresirani za rad s tehnologijom u trgovini.
• Posjeduju snažnu želju za učenjem i daljnjim razvojem.
• Fleksibilni i orijentiran na aktivnosti.

TKO SMO?

H&M Group je globalna kompanija snažnih modnih brendova i pothvata. Cilj nam je dokazati kako ne postoji kompromis između iznimnog dizajna, pristupačnih cijena i održivih rješenja. Želimo modu svima učiniti dostupnom, a naši kupci su u središtu svake naše odluke koju donosimo.

Čine nas tisuće strastvenih i talentiranih kolega, ujedinjenih zajedničkom kulturom te vrijednostima. Zajedno želimo iskoristiti svoju snagu, svoje postignuće i znanje kako bismo usmjerili modnu industriju prema inkluzivnijoj i održivijoj budućnosti.

ZAŠTO ĆEŠ VOLJETI RADITI OVDJE?

U H&M Grupi, ponosni smo na to što smo energična i gostoljubiva kompanija. Našim zaposlenicima nudimo atraktivne pogodnosti s opsežnim mogućnostima razvoja diljem svijeta.

• 10% popusta za djelatnike na sve naše H&M Group robne marke, kako u trgovinama tako i online
• H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Više o programu saznaj ovdje.​
• Privatno zdravstveno dopunsko i dodatno osiguranje
• Nagrada za dugogodišnji rad za 10, 15 & 20 godina
• Naknada za topli obrok
• Nagrada za umirovljenje
• Dar za vjenčanje
• Program preporuke

Naša jedinstvenost proizlazi iz kombinacije mnogih faktora– naše inkluzivne i suradničke kulture, naših snažnih vrijednosti i prilika za rast no ponajviše naših ljudi koji nas čine onim što jesmo.​

Zajedno s nama napravi sljedeći korak u svojoj karijeri. Putovanje počinje ovdje.​

* Proces selekcije kandidata:

Radi efikasnog upravljanja s velikim brojem prijava za ulogu prodajnog savjetnika, koristimo online regrutacijsku metodu procjene koja se temelji na vještinama u nekim od naših trgovina. Morat ćeš ih ispuniti kao dio postupka prijave i provjere. Tvoji odgovori bit će ocjenjeni alatom za procjenu koji primjenjuje unaprijed definirane kriterije koje je postavila H&M Grupa.

Nakon dovršetka procjene imat ćeš priliku podijeliti povratne informacije i postaviti pitanja. Ako naiđeš na bilo kakve poteškoće ili preferiraš alternativnu metodu procjene, obrati se na recruitment_support@hm.com. Odabir alternativne metode neće utjecati na tvoju prijavu.

Više informacija o tome kako obrađujemo tvoje osobne podatke, pronađi u našoj Politici privatnosti.

** Predani smo procesu zapošljavanja koji je pošten, pravedan i temelji se na kompetencijama. Stoga te molimo da svojoj prijavi ne prilažeš motivacijsko pismo.​

jobs.title: Principal Associate - IT
jobs.description:
ROLE: L3+ Intune / Endpoint Management Administrator

REPORTING TO: ITISC FET Europe Workspace Manager

WORKING LOCATION: Coimbatore

WORK TIMING: 12PM – 9PM

OBJECTIVE:

We are seeking a highly skilled L3+ Microsoft Intune Administrator with deep technical expertise in modern cloud-based endpoint management, identity integration, and endpoint security. You will serve as the primary escalation point for complex infrastructure, deployment, and security compliance issues. You will optimize our global device fleet, manage Windows Autopilot, handle co-management setups with SCCM/MECM, and enforce robust security policies across multi-platform environments (Windows, iOS, Android)

What You’ll Do

Architecture, Configuration, & Deployment

Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-grade Microsoft Intune infrastructure and configuration profiles.

Manage end-to-end Windows Autopilot deployment profiles, zero-touch provisioning, and device lifecycle management.

Configure and administer Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) device registration, join states, dynamic groups, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

Oversee Windows Update for Business rings, feature updates, quality updates, and compliance deadlines.

Support and manage co-management workflows bridging SCCM (MECM) and Microsoft Intune.

Plan and execute the SCCM (MECM) to Intune migration.

Application & Package Management

Package, test, and deploy enterprise applications (Win32 apps, MSI, Microsoft Store, and shell scripts/PowerShell) via Intune.

Troubleshoot complex application installation failures, dependency issues, and supersede rules across diverse endpoints.

Security, Compliance, & Monitoring

Configure and manage Endpoint Security baselines, BitLocker encryption, Firewall, Antivirus, and Attack Surface Reduction (ASR) rules.

Coordinate with compliance team for threat monitoring, vulnerability management, and automated remediation.

Administer Mobile Device Management (MDM) and Mobile Application Management (MAM) policies for corporate and BYOD environments

Advanced Troubleshooting & L3 Operations

Act as the ultimate technical escalation point for L1/L2 helpdesk teams regarding enrolment blockages, policy sync failures, and compliance errors.

Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring system disruptions or wide-scale deployment failures.

Automate routine administrative tasks and reporting using PowerShell and Microsoft Graph API.

What You Bring

Experience in Intune, Vuln fixing, SCCM, Patching, Packaging.

Strong troubleshooting skills, especially with Windows and M365, Intune, SCCM, Packaging, Patching.

Excellent communication skills in English

A proactive, “can-do” attitude and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to Have

Experience with Power shell scripting, Windows Server, Active Directory, or networking.

Familiarity with BMC Helix ticketing system

ITIL Foundation certification.

Knowledge of Azure.

Why Join Us?

Work in a vibrant, multicultural team in India

Be part of a company that values growth, learning, and internal mobility.

Gain exposure to a modern IT environment supporting critical business operations.

Clear path to leadership for ambitious professionals.

Personal Skills:

Team Player

Smart worker

Quick learner

Willingness to work in off business hours with On call setup in needed.

Qualification: Bachelor's degree or comparable education

Experience – 8 – 12+ Years (with 4+ years dedicated to Microsoft Intune)

PREFERED CANDIDATES:

The successful candidate will have a self-motivated, get-it-done attitude; the ability to think critically; enjoy working

Additional Information

Travel Requirements: Occasional travel (10%-20%, depending on project phase) to regional offices, subsidiaries, or project sites may be required to support specific project events and activities,

Work Environment: The role is transversal and collaborative, interacting with Finance, multidisciplinary IT teams (e.g. BAs, Developers, Architects), external Partner and corporate and regional business + IT teams in a multicultural and international environment,

Contract Type & Location: Minimum contract duration: 1 Year with high probability for extension to 2 Years. B2B preferred, with flexibility for hybrid remote collaboration with international teams. Permanent contract considerable.

Professional Development: Opportunities to enhance and gain practical and solid software development knowledge and skills in building global D365FO/SCM solutions, and participate in global rollout projects,

Key Attributes: Very strong technical knowledge, software design patterns and analytical thinking, problem-solving, and self-organization skill with ability to balance delivery quality, timeline and costs.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled DevOps Engineer to support, maintain, and evolve a critical pricing generation and distribution system for Fixed Income (FI) products.

In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring platform reliability, improving deployment processes, driving automation initiatives, and supporting both cloud-native and legacy workloads. You will collaborate closely with development, architecture, and infrastructure teams to modernize the platform and enhance operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Operations & Infrastructure

• Manage and maintain Linux-based environments.
• Support and troubleshoot containerized workloads using technologies such as Docker and Podman.
• Investigate and resolve production incidents and platform issues.
• Support hybrid deployments across private and public cloud environments.
• Ensure platform stability, availability, and performance.

Automation & DevOps Engineering

• Develop, maintain, and enhance automation scripts using Bash.
• Design and improve CI/CD pipelines to streamline software delivery.
• Contribute to infrastructure automation and operational efficiency initiatives.
• Promote DevOps best practices across the platform ecosystem.

Monitoring & Observability

• Maintain and enhance monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions.
• Build and support dashboards and telemetry systems.
• Proactively identify performance bottlenecks and reliability risks.
• Improve observability capabilities to support business-critical applications.

Collaboration & Platform Modernization

• Partner with software engineers, architects, and infrastructure teams on deployment and modernization initiatives.
• Support the migration and transformation of legacy systems.
• Contribute to platform improvement projects and cloud adoption strategies.

Required Skills & Experience

• Strong hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting Linux environments.
• Practical experience with container technologies such as Docker and Podman.
• Advanced Bash scripting skills, including the ability to develop and maintain complex automation scripts.
• Experience with AWS services and managing hybrid deployments across private and public cloud environments.
• Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including network interfaces, routing, connectivity, and performance troubleshooting.
• Experience with CI/CD and automation tooling such as Jenkins, TeamCity, Ansible, or similar technologies.
• Knowledge of monitoring and observability platforms such as Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, or equivalent solutions.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Delivery-oriented mindset with a focus on reliability and continuous improvement.
• Professional level of English (written and spoken).

Nice to Have

• Development experience in C# or Java, with an understanding of .NET or JVM-based applications.
• Experience with application lifecycle management and operational support.
• Knowledge of Linux CPU architecture, memory management, and performance tuning.
• Experience migrating and modernizing large legacy platforms.
• Experience designing and implementing complex deployment pipelines.
• Experience managing and supporting self-hosted tooling and infrastructure services.

What do we offer you?

• Remote within Spain Time zone.
• Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects.
• CET working hours

If you have read this far and you are looking forward to joining this challenge, do not hesitate to apply... we would be delighted to meet you!

jobs.title: 6-month paid internship - AI & Automation
jobs.description:
HOW CAN YOU HELP US?

Are you eager to strengthen your Artificial Intelligence (AI), Automation, Data Analytics, and Digital Transformation skills? Eurofins BioPharma Product Testing is looking for an AI & Automation Intern to join the Central Information Technology (IT) Solutions team based in Barcelona, Spain.

As an AI and Automation Intern, you will:

Develop and implement AI agents using Microsoft Copilot and related technologies. You will improve AI knowledge bases using internal documentation and operational procedures and support the creation of AI-driven knowledge management and self-service solutions.

Contribute to automation and digital transformation initiatives that simplify business processes and improve efficiency across Eurofins BioPharma Product Testing laboratories in Europe.

Analyse and structure data to generate actionable insights, support reporting and trend analysis, and help drive data-based decisions.

Support cross-functional projects with teams across Europe and contribute to process improvement and digital transformation initiatives.

WHAT CAN WE DO FOR YOU?

As part of your role, you will support impactful projects supporting scientists, laboratory professionals, and IT teams across multiple countries. This is a unique opportunity to develop your skills alongside experienced IT professionals and play an active role in the digital transformation of a global network of laboratories.

Contract type: End-of-study internship.

This internship is compensated. To apply, you must provide an internship agreement from your university.

Start date: October - November 2026.

Duration: 6 months.

ARE YOU OUR KIND OF EXTRAORDINARY?

Education: Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, Software Engineering, Automation, or any related fields.

Languages: Professional proficiency in English is required. Any additional languages are a plus.

Technical Knowledge: Exposure to data analytics, automation, and AI technology (e.g., Python, SQL, Power BI, Power Automate, and Microsoft Power Platform & system integrations) is a plus.

We support your development! Do you feel like you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

We embrace diversity!  As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Eurofins network of companies believes in strength and innovation through diversity. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

Find out more on our Careers page: https://careers.eurofins.com/

Company description: Eurofins Scientific is an international network of independent life sciences companies, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In under 40 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 employees across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of over 950 laboratories in over 1,000 independent companies across 57 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

The Eurofins network generated EUR 7.296 billion revenues in FY 2025, and has been one of the fastest growing listed European companies for almost three decades.

jobs.title: Asistent i shitjes 25 orë  PRISHTINA Mall
jobs.description:
ÇFARË DO TË BËSH​

Si një këshilltar shitjesh, do të luash një rol kyç në krijimin e një përvoje të jashtëzakonshme për klientin. Do të mirëpresësh klientët, do t'i udhëzosh nëpër butik dhe do t'i ndihmosh në gjetjen e asaj që u nevojitet gjatë ekspozimit të produkteve tona. Duke vepruar në përputhje me vlerat tona, do të kontribuosh si në suksesin tënd ashtu edhe në suksesin e kompanisë.

Do të:

• Ndash njohuritë tua mbi modën dhe produktin për të ndihmuar klientët të bëjnë zgjedhje të formuara.
• Bashkëpunosh me ekipin tënd për të ofruar shërbime të jashtëzakonshme në çdo hap të udhëtimit të klientit
• Sigurosh që kati i shitjeve dhe pjesa e pasme të jenë të pajisura mirë, të organizuara dhe tërheqëse.
• Ndihmosh ne hapjen dhe mbylljen e butikut.
• Përfaqësosh pozitivisht veten dhe markën gjatë të gjitha ndërveprimeve me klientët.

​

​ME KË DO TË PUNOSH​

Butikët tanë janë zemra e kompanisë sonë, ku klientët e përjetojnë markën tonë nga dora e parë. Si pjesë e ekipit dinamik të butikut, çdo rol—nga këshilltarët e shitjeve, menaxherët e departamenteve, menaxherët e butikëve dhe merçandajzerët vizual deri te Cash Office Responsible—kontribuon në krijimin e një mjedisi frymëzues dhe mikpritës. Gjithashtu do të lidhesh me ekipin e zonës më të gjerë, duke bashkëpunuar me butikë për të ndarë njohuri dhe për të nxitur suksesin së bashku. Krahas ekipit tënd, do të luash një rol jetësor për të ndihmuar klientët të ndihen të sigurt dhe të shprehin individualitetin e tyre me trendët më të fundit dhe stilet e përjetshme. Duke ndërtuar lidhje domethënëse me klientët në butikët tanë, ne e bëjmë modën të qasshme dhe të qëndrueshme për të gjithë.

​

KUSH JE TI​

Ne po kërkojmë persona me…​

• Përvojë në shërbime të klientëve në fushën e modës, shitjes me pakicë ose fusha të ngjashme do të konsiderohet si avantazh.
• Pasion për të ndihmuar klientët dhe një interes për modën ose shitjen me pakicë – ne do t'ju mësojmë pjesën tjetër!

Dhe persona të…​

• Lulëzojnë në mjedise bashkëpunuese dhe dinamike.
• Janë komunikues, kreativ, kureshtar për të punuar me teknologjinë e butikëve, me një dëshirë të fortë për të mësuar dhe zhvilluar.
• Fleksibil dhe të orientuar drejt veprimit.

KUSH JEMI NE​

H&M Group është një kompani globale e markave dhe ndërmarrjeve të fuqishme të modës. Qëllimi ynë është të vërtetojmë se nuk ka kompromis ndërmjet dizajnit të jashtëzakonshëm, çmimeve të përballueshme dhe zgjidhjeve të qëndrueshme. Ne duam të çlirojmë modën për shumë njerëz dhe klientët tanë janë në qendër të çdo vendimi që marrim.​

​Ne përbëhemi nga mijëra kolegë të pasionuar dhe të talentuar të bashkuar nga kultura dhe vlerat tona të përbashkëta. Së bashku, ne duam të përdorim fuqinë tonë, madhësinë tonë dhe njohuritë tona për të shtyrë industrinë e modës drejt një të ardhmeje më gjithëpërfshirëse dhe të qëndrueshme. ​

​

PSE DO TË JU PËLQEJË TË PUNONI KËTU ​

Në H&M Group jemi krenarë që jemi një kompani e gjallë dhe mikpritëse. Ne u ofrojmë punëtorëve tanë përfitime tërheqëse me mundësi të gjera zhvillimi në mbarë globin. ​

• 25% zbritje për stafin në të gjitha markat tona të H&M Group, si në butikë ashtu edhe në internet
• H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Më shumë rreth programit mund të mësosh këtu.
• Sigurim Shëndetësor Privat
• Shpërblim për Shërbimin e Gjatë
• Pushim i atësisë
• Shpërblim për pensionim
• Kartelë Dhurate për Foshnje
• Bonus për referimin një mik

BASHKOHU ME NE​

E veçanta jonë buron nga një kombinim i shumë gjërave – kultura jonë gjithëpërfshirëse dhe bashkëpunuese, vlerat tona të forta dhe mundësitë për rritje. Por mbi të gjitha, janë njerëzit tanë ata që na bëjnë ata që jemi.​

Hidhe hapin tjetër në karrierën tënde së bashku me ne. Udhëtimi fillon këtu.

*Vlerësimi i Roleve në Dyqan:

Për të menaxhuar volumin e lartë të aplikimeve për rolin e Këshilltarit të Shitjeve, ne përdorim një metodë vlerësimi online për rekrutimin e bazuar në aftësi në disa nga dyqanet tona. Do t’ju duhet ta përfundoni atë si pjesë e procesit të aplikimit dhe përzgjedhjes. Përgjigjet tuaja do të vlerësohen nga një mjet vlerësimi që zbaton kriteret e paracaktuara nga Grupi H&M.

Pasi të keni përfunduar vlerësimin, do të keni mundësinë të jepni komente dhe të bëni pyetje. Nëse hasni vështirësi ose preferoni një metodë alternative vlerësimi, ju lutemi kontaktoni: recruitment_support@hm.com. Zgjedhja e një alternative nuk do të ndikojë në aplikimin tuaj.

Për më shumë informacion mbi mënyrën se si përpunojmë të dhënat tuaja personale, ju lutemi shikoni Njoftimin tonë të Privatësisë.

*Ne jemi të përkushtuar ndaj një procesi rekrutimi që është i drejtë, i barabartë dhe i bazuar në kompetenca. Prandaj, ju lusim të mos bashkëngjitni letër motivuese në aplikacionin tuaj.​

jobs.title: Analyst/ Senior Analyst, Pricing Optimization (Bangkok Based, relocation provided)
jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. This department is highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers through measurable marketing programs and channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. The marketing leadership at Agoda have deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields and have built an organization that thrives on data, creative ideas, and technology. The Performance Marketing Team also fosters a great learning environment. You will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

In this role you'll get to:

• Experimentation and optimizing campaign performance: Experiment with pricing strategies on different traffic and segments. Adapt to new product features and roll out changes from successful tests.

• Modeling: Analyze vast amounts of data generated by experiments, develop predictive models using data science techniques (eg. understanding demand elasticity from pricing optimization) and liaise with product teams on implementation roadmap

• Reporting, analysis and insights: Building dashboards to track performance, derive insights, understand growth levers and communicate recommendations via presentations to stakeholders

What you’ll Need to Succeed:

• Bachelor’s Degree or higher from top university in a quantitative subject (computer science, mathematics, engineering, or science)

• Ability to communicate fluently in English

• 2+ years’ experience in top-tier management consulting, investment banking, private equity, or strategy/business operations for a fast-growing globally operating tech company

• Exposure to one or more data analysis packages or databases, e.g., SAS, R, SPSS, Python, VBA, SQL

• Good numerical reasoning skills

• Proficiency in Excel

• Intellectual curiosity

It’s Great if you Have:

• Experience in digital marketing

• Academic research experience

Con más de 100 años de historia, somos líderes en el sector de la movilidad premium. Nuestro equipo de Sales es el motor que impulsa las relaciones con los actores clave del sector turístico para maximizar la rentabilidad. Si tienes pasión por las ventas, vocación de servicio y te apasiona el mundo del motor, SIXT es tu lugar.

• Eres una persona colaborativa, con experiencia coordinando acciones con equipos multidisciplinares y con ganas de contribuir al éxito colectivo del equipo

jobs.title: Launch Engineer
jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Position Overview

The Launch Engineer is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing all launch activities associated with new vehicle programs, engineering changes, and manufacturing readiness. This role serves as a key interface between Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Logistics, Program Management, and Product Development teams to ensure successful vehicle launches from concept through Start of Production (SOP). The Launch Engineer leads readiness assessments, build event coordination, issue management, validation activities, and operational readiness execution to ensure safety, quality, cost, timing, and volume objectives are achieved.

Key Responsibilities

1. Launch Planning & Readiness

• Support the development and execution of launch plans for new vehicle programs and major product changes.

• Update launch deliverables, milestones, and readiness criteria.

• Coordinate cross-functional activities to ensure launch requirements are achieved.

• Monitor launch timing and escalate risks that may impact program objectives.

• Support Open-to-Go assessments and build readiness reviews.

2. Build Event Coordination

• Lead preparation and execution of prototype, pilot, validation, and production builds.

• Coordinate vehicle scheduling and build plans with all participating functions.

• Ensure materials, tooling, equipment, manpower, and documentation are available and ready.

• Facilitate daily build reviews and issue resolution meetings.

• Track build performance metrics and lessons learned.

3. Issue Management & Problem Resolution

• Collect, document, prioritize, and monitor launch-related issues.

• Drive closure plans with responsible teams.

• Utilize structured problem-solving methodologies to resolve launch issues.

• Escalate critical issues to leadership when required.

• Track issue trends and support management reporting.

4. Manufacturing Readiness

• Assess manufacturing process readiness against launch requirements.

• Support validation of equipment, tooling, automation, software, and production systems.

• Verify operational readiness of manufacturing shops.

• Ensure readiness metrics are achieved prior to production milestones.

5. Product & Process Validation

• Support new product introduction (NPI) activities.

• Coordinate vehicle and process validation builds.

• Ensure engineering changes are properly implemented and validated.

• Track launch quality metrics and process capability indicators.

• Support root cause analysis and corrective action implementation.

6. Cross-Functional Leadership

• Facilitate communication between Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Program Management, Logistics, and Supplier teams.

• Drive alignment on launch priorities and deliverables.

• Lead launch meetings and action-item tracking.

• Provide launch status updates to management and executive leadership.

7. Reporting & Governance

• Develop launch readiness dashboards and reports.

• Maintain launch scorecards and milestone trackers.

• Support Launch Governance Reviews and executive launch reporting.

• Present launch status, risks, countermeasures, and recovery plans.

8. Continuous Improvement

• Capture lessons learned from launch activities.

• Support development of launch standards and best practices.

• Identify opportunities to improve launch efficiency and risk management processes.

• Contribute to future program readiness and organizational learning.

Skills

• Deep understanding of vehicle assembly.

• Understanding of APQP principles

• Aware of Project management fundamentals

• Experience with Data analysis and reporting tools

• Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint)

• Experience launching manufacturing and production lines.

• Hands-on experience with process validation, commissioning, and manufacturing quality systems.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Mechatronics Engineering (Master’s preferred).

• 3+ years of experience in automotive manufacturing.

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

Equal Opportunity: At Lucid, we believe diversity strengthens everything we build. Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations.

Accessibility: Lucid Motors is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need any accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at TA-Operations <@> lucidmotors.com. This email address is designated solely for accommodation requests and is not monitored for job applications or resume submissions. To be considered for employment, all applications must be submitted through the Lucid Motors Careers website.

Candidate Data Privacy: By submitting your application, you understand and agree that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Customer Success Specialist - 6 month FTC (parental leave cover)
jobs.description:
BUILD SOMETHING MONUMENTAL FOR HEALTHCARE!




At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!



Who you are

 - You care deeply about customers and love solving problems quickly and clearly.

 - You have proven experience in customer support, customer success, operations, or a service desk role (SaaS/healthtech is a plus).

 - You’re calm under pressure and can handle high volumes of tickets and calls with empathy.

 - You’re highly organised: you document, prioritise, and follow up reliably.

 - You communicate clearly in Dutch and English.

 - You can explain technical issues in simple terms and coordinate with internal teams to get things fixed.



What you will do

 - Be the front line for customers: handle support tickets and incoming phone calls, resolving issues quickly.

 - Triage and prioritise: identify urgent issues (e.g., workflow blockers) and escalate appropriately.

 - Maintain customer relationships: ensure users feel heard, supported, and successful with Tandem.

 - Lead onboarding & training logistics: help schedule sessions, share materials, and ensure users know the basics.

 - Create and improve support content: FAQs, troubleshooting guides, and internal knowledge base articles.

 - Track recurring issues: surface patterns and product feedback to reduce future support load.



Nice to have

 - Experience supporting healthcare customers or clinicians.

 - Familiarity with helpdesk tooling (e.g., Zendesk/Intercom/Freshdesk) and CRM hygiene.

 - Basic technical troubleshooting experience (browser/audio settings, permissions, integration basics).



What you will get

 - The opportunity to grow your career while making a meaningful impact on the future of healthcare within a fast-growing European healthtech scale-up

 - Competitive salary

 - Regular team outings and social events

 - A dog-friendly office



Location

We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This is a full-time role based in Leiden, the Netherlands for an initial period of 6 months. 

Some travel may be required to support major deployments, but most work will be customer-facing and remote/office-based.


CULTURE AT TANDEM


At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

jobs.title: Analyst/Senior Analyst, Brand Marketing (Bangkok Based, Relocation provided)
jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

Agoda's Brand Marketing team is looking for an Analyst to scale our digital marketing & brand research efforts.

As a part of the Brand Media & Measurement team, you will manage digital campaign planning, A/B testing, and reporting across key digital channels like Meta, Twitter, YouTube etc., and also be responsible for management & analysis of brand research projects.

This person will have the opportunity to learn and grow with the global Brand Marketing team based in Thailand. They will play a key role in analyzing all kind of campaign & research data to deliver insights that will shape the team’s strategy and fulfil our ambition of creating an engaging and meaningful brand in the tech-and-travel space.

This role is based out of Agoda’s Global Operations Center in Bangkok, Thailand, giving the successful applicant the once-in-a-lifetime chance to work in one of the world’s most exciting and fast-paced cities, close to some of the most iconic travel destinations, with a fun and talented team. We provide complete relocation for you and your family and excellent benefits.

About the Brand team

We are the guardians of the Agoda brand, with a mission to make Agoda a trusted name in global travel. Our scope is broad and encompasses various projects and collaborations with other departments at Agoda. In any given week, we could be working on campaign creation and activation (including consumer research, strategy, agency management, media planning, measurement, and testing), producing assets for Agoda’s various marketing channels and our website and app, or designing official Agoda merch for our offices around the globe. We ensure the brand is always looking and sounding its best in everything we do, whether on the world stage or in a company newsletter.

The Brand team is diverse, representing strategists, media planners, project managers, brand managers, creatives, and more, from different walks of life. We have in common a love of travel (and travel deals) and a passion for finding fun and innovative ways to bring the Agoda brand to the world.

In this role, you’ll get to:

• Experiment: Conduct A/B testing on platforms like Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, TikTok and YouTube, as well as brand research in-house & with external agencies to demonstrate the impact of campaign activity on brand awareness.

• Execute: Own the performance of digital & social campaigns, optimize critical campaign metrics, and keep an eye on data to ensure that media is delivering against the plan.

• Learn: Communicate test results & campaign learnings to the team and broader stakeholders through comprehensive analysis, reporting and data visualization. Develop key learnings for different media platforms and markets.

• Analyse: Delve into data from digital tests & research studies to gather useful insights for optimization of brand campaigns.

• Collaborate: Liaise with external media partners (e.g. Google, Meta) for planning, analysis and execution, and consolidate media data and analysis with digital activity being run in-house.

What you’ll need to succeed:

• A minimum of a bachelor’s degree in mathematics, marketing, communication, business, or another related field

• At least 2 years of experience in analytically focused positions

• Great SQL & Tableau knowledge

• Advanced knowledge of Excel, very comfortable using VLOOKUP and Pivot Tables

• Great project management, measurement, and planning capability; taking ownership from the start to the finish

• Knowledge of statistics and data processing practices (calculating p-values, data cleaning and normalization, regressions, etc.) is a plus

jobs.title: Senior Zip System Specialist(Contract Role)
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Location: Bengaluru, India

About the department
The Oracle Team, part of Cloudflare's DIA and Enterprise systems organization, manages the complete end-to-end operation of our S2P processes. This ensures consistent processes across all functional areas, enabling Cloudflare's internal teams to work efficiently and facilitating business interactions with customers and partners.

Position Overview
Drive the strategy and execution of our global procurement technology ecosystem. Our architecture leverages Zip (Zip HQ) as the premier intake and orchestration layer, integrated natively with Oracle Fusion Cloud as our financial system of record.The ideal candidate is a Procurement technologist who understands the nuances of the entire Source-to-Pay (S2P) lifecycle. You will bridge the gap between user-centric intake and rigorous financial controls, ensuring that complex business requirements from Legal, Finance, and Global Sourcing are translated into seamless, automated workflows that maintain data integrity
across both Zip and Oracle.

What You Will Do
● End-to-End Process Architecture: Design and optimize the global S2P process,ensuring a frictionless hand-off between upstream sourcing/intake (Zip) and downstream purchasing/payables (Oracle Fusion).
● Dual-Platform Configuration: Act as the functional lead for both Zip and Oracle Fusion Procurement. Build complex intake workflows in Zip while simultaneously configuring Requisitioning, Purchasing, and Supplier Portals in Oracle to match.
● Integration Ecosystem Management: Own the functional health of the Zip-to-Oracle integration. Monitor data flow for Requisitions, Purchase Orders, and Supplier Master Data, ensuring that "In-Flight" changes in one system are accurately reflected in the other.
● Strategic Business Partnership: Lead discovery sessions with Global Procurement, Legal, and Accounting. Translate high-level business policies into precise logic within the tech stack.
● Data Governance & Compliance: Ensure that the "System of Record" (Oracle) remains audit-ready. Manage the mapping of Category Codes, Cost Centers, and Tax attributes between the Zip UI and the Oracle GL.

• Release Management: Manage the quarterly update cycles for both Zip and Oracle.Conduct impact assessments on new features to ensure no disruption to the integrated workflow.

Required Qualifications
● Platform Proficiency: 3+ years of hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Procurement (Self-Service Procurement, Purchasing, Supplier Model) and 2+ years of experience with Zip (Zip HQ).
● Procurement Subject Matter Expertise: Deep understanding of the Source-to-Pay (S2P) lifecycle, including PR/PO lifecycle, 3-way matching, Encumbrance Accounting,and Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM).
● Integration Fluency: Proven experience managing API-based integrations between Intake-to-Procure tools and Tier-1 ERPs. You should understand how a Zip "Approval translates into an Oracle "Approved Requisition."
● Process Engineering: Ability to map complex, cross-functional business processes and identify opportunities for automation or bottleneck removal.
● Systems Thinking: You don't just fix a field; you understand how changing a workflow in Zip impacts the General Ledger and AP downstream in Oracle.

The Tech Stack
● Orchestration: Zip (Intake, Sourcing, Vendor Management)
● Core ERP / Financials: Oracle Fusion Cloud (Procurement, Payables, GL)
● Contracts (CLM): Ironclad

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

jobs.title: Department Supervisor - Waikiki Business Plaza
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Department Supervisor, you will be responsible for for supporting the Sales and Profit goals in the store by executing a plan to deliver the Best Customer Experience in the department and overall store. The Department Supervisor will work in accordance with legal requirements and H&M standards, policies, and procedures to meet the expectations of customers and colleagues.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• You are responsible for supporting the total OMNI customer experience in your store, ensuring visual and commercial curation according to global guidelines.
• Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during customer interactions
• Be aware of and take responsibility of your department's strengths and identifying commercial opportunities and working with your Department Manager to act on them
• Ensure customer service is provided in all areas of the store and that your team has the ability to work towards actively promoting and selling products to customers
• Following up that your team is actively promoting our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Ensure correct routines in fitting room and checkout, including transaction, returns and exchanges
• Ensure all admin routines for both people and operations are handled in a correct way

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors and relevant influencers, etc
• Ensure your team provides product and fashion knowledge as well as other relevant information during customer interactions

Team & Development

• Retain and share your knowledge and skills with the Store team
• Collaboration, planning & teamwork with in-store Visual Merchandiser team
• Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
• Regular communication to store colleagues to inform, motivate and inspire – daily, weekly meetings, etc
• Ensure all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store are followed

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

• Secure a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house including stockroom areas
• Ensure high fashion quality, visual and commercial product presentation, with good garment care
• Secure good stock levels and provide input on allocation to Area team
• Ensure the full garment cycle – from delivery to garment presentation – and fitting room routines are according to our standards and routines set internally, utilizing all tools and technology provided
• Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
• Secure a strong balance and the maintenance of price signs in-store and throughout the sales floor/store following guidelines according to global and local strategies & sales market/regional requirements to ensure a strong and consistent price perception throughout store
• Updating & upkeep of BOH Areas for all colleagues (key information, health & safety, tidiness etc)
• Responsible for opening & closing of store daily

Who You Are

• To be a successful and effective Department Supervisor, you’ll be an emerging leader who enjoys taking responsibility.
• You must be ambitious, an effective communicator, supportive, an analytical solution finder, capable of working with numbers and managing statistics.
• You are achievement-oriented, motivated by performance and competition to be truly customer centric.

Why You’ll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You’ll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work
• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

EEOC Code: SLS

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organisation. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence all diversity dimensions are taken into consideration in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

At H&M, our purpose is to liberate fashion for the many. We want to shape a new world in Fashion. A world with one ultimate goal: to unleash your self-expression. As an H&M colleague, you’re encouraged to be yourself & more. You’ll take on new responsibilities from day one, learn skills for life, and find new ways to make your big dreams come true.

jobs.title: Coordinador Junior de Mantenimiento de Edificios y Seguridad
jobs.description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

Coordinador Junior de Mantenimiento de Edificios y Seguridad

El Puesto

Como Building Maintenance & Security Coordinator para la nueva sede de Ebury en León, serás el punto de referencia para todas las operaciones técnicas y de atención de la oficina.

Serás responsable de transformar unas instalaciones recién adquiridas en una experiencia de oficina de primer nivel, asegurando que todos los sistemas complejos del edificio —desde la energía hasta el control climático avanzado— se gestionen con los más altos estándares.

Actuarás como el "Representante de la Propiedad", garantizando un tiempo de inactividad cero (zero-downtime) para nuestra infraestructura crítica. Serás responsable del valor a largo plazo y la resiliencia del activo, yendo más allá del mantenimiento diario hacia la gestión estratégica de activos y la descarbonización.

Reportarás directamente al Head of Global Business Services, quien actuará como el principal interesado en la infraestructura local y la seguridad de los empleados, y también tendrás un responsable clave a nivel local, el Director de Ebury León. Además, trabajarás en conjunto con el Office Manager de León.

Responsabilidades

• Operaciones de Instalaciones y Sistemas Críticos 24/7: Responsable del funcionamiento eficaz de todos los servicios contratados de las instalaciones, gestionando específicamente el BMS (Sistema de Gestión de Edificios), el sistema de climatización (HVAC), la ventilación (UTA) y el mantenimiento general del edificio. Mantenimiento de Infraestructura Crítica: Supervisar el mantenimiento planificado y ad hoc de los sistemas SAI (Sistemas de Alimentación Ininterrumpida / UPS), los cuadros eléctricos y la fontanería del edificio para garantizar el 100% de la continuidad operativa.

• Operaciones Críticas 24/7 y Gestión de Activos: Continuidad del Negocio y Respuesta a Emergencias: Establecer y liderar un protocolo de respuesta a emergencias técnicas 24/7 para garantizar el tiempo de actividad de los sistemas críticos, incluidos los SAI, la refrigeración de la sala de servidores y los sistemas de seguridad. jobs.title: Building Maintenance & Security Junior Coordinator
jobs.description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

León Building Maintenance & Security Junior Coordinator

The Role

As the Building Maintenance & Security Coordinator for Ebury's new headquarters in León, you will be the single point of contact for all technical and office support operations. You will be responsible for transforming newly acquired facilities into a first-class office experience, ensuring that all complex building systems—from power to advanced climate control—are managed to the highest standards.

You will act as the "Property Representative," guaranteeing zero downtime for our critical infrastructure. You will be responsible for the long-term value and resilience of the asset, moving beyond day-to-day maintenance toward strategic asset management and decarbonization.

You will report directly to the Head of Global Business Services, who will act as the primary stakeholder for local infrastructure and employee safety, and you will also have a key local stakeholder, the Director of Ebury León. Additionally, you will work side-by-side with the León Office Manager.

Responsibilities

24/7 Facility Operations & Critical Systems

• Responsible for the effective operation of all contracted facility services, specifically managing the BMS (Building Management System), HVAC system, ventilation (AHU/UTA), and general building maintenance.

• Critical Infrastructure Maintenance: Oversee planned and ad hoc maintenance of UPS systems (Uninterruptible Power Supply), electrical panels, and building plumbing to guarantee 100% operational continuity.

24/7 Critical Operations & Asset Management

• Business Continuity & Emergency Response: Establish and lead a 24/7 technical emergency response protocol to guarantee uptime for critical systems, including UPS, server room cooling, and security systems.

• Advanced Security Supervision: Manage 24/7 security protocols, including multi-zone access control and integrated CCTV monitoring in coordination with the security vendor.

• Property Regulatory Compliance: Guarantee 100% compliance with all statutory inspections (OCA, Fire Safety, Legionella, Elevator safety) to mitigate Ebury's legal and operational risks.

• Vendor Management: Manage relationships with key technical vendors (General Maintenance, Elevators, Security/Fire Protection, and Utilities).

Safety & Compliance

• Duty of Care: Lead Health & Safety programs with comprehensive policies for the office and 24/7 shifts.

• Total Compliance: Responsible for ensuring Health & Safety compliance in accordance with local Spanish regulations, ensuring all mandatory inspections (electrical OCA, fire safety, and elevators) are completed as the property owner.

Projects & Sustainability

• Project Coordination: Lead moves and project coordination, including the upcoming renovation of the ground-floor commercial space and the potential installation of rooftop photovoltaic panels.

• Environmental Supervision: Oversee specialised services, such as Building Maintenance Units (Gondolas/BMU) for facade care, and supervise waste management and pest control.

Skills, Experience & Qualifications

Experience

• Solid Industry Experience: A minimum of two years in corporate office management, hospitality environments, or high-traffic complex facilities.

• Seamless Operations (Zero-Downtime): Proven track record in maintaining 24/7 mission-critical centres, such as operations rooms or global headquarters, where infrastructure resilience is paramount.

Education & Technical Credentials

• Technical Background: A Vocational Training degree (Formación Profesional) focused on the electrical field or similar technical disciplines is highly desirable.

Technical Mastery & Systems

• Fundamental Maintenance: Practical, hands-on proficiency in general electrical systems, plumbing, and climate control operations.

• Specialised Infrastructure: Comprehensive understanding of UPS redundancy, electrical load balancing, and RITE regulations.

• Software & Digital Controls: Direct experience using Building Management System (BMS) software for environmental monitoring.

• Practical Skills: High level of manual dexterity and a strict focus on safety when operating various technical tools.

Strategic Assets & Technical Documentation

• Asset Management: Proficiency in managing as-built technical records and maintenance histories to preserve long-term asset value and regulatory compliance status.

Language & Interpersonal Skills

• Multilingual Capability: Fluency in English and Spanish, essential for coordinating with global teams and negotiating with local service vendors.

Key Competencies

• Problem Solver: Analytical mindset capable of quickly identifying and resolving building issues, such as thermal bridges or moisture infiltration.

• Self-Sufficient: Ability to independently prioritise urgent technical tasks, demonstrating meticulous attention to detail and office upkeep.

• Operational Resilience: Calm and focused demeanour during high-pressure scenarios involving critical infrastructure or end-of-life equipment.

• Leadership: Taking ultimate ownership over total building operability and smooth facility operations.

Benefits & Value Proposition

• Competitive Compensation: Salary package commensurate with experience and position responsibility.

• Work-Life Balance & Flexibility: Results-oriented flexible hours that enable professional and personal balance.

• Long-Term Growth: Stable employment within a strategic project linked to the new corporate headquarters.

• Comprehensive Well-Being: Access to private healthcare programs and flexible benefits schemes.

Why Ebury?

• Competitive Starting Salary with an annual discretionary bonus that truly rewards your performance from day one.

• Dedicated Mentorship: Learn directly from experienced managers who are invested in your success.

• Cutting-Edge Technology: Leverage state-of-the-art tailor made tools and systems that enable you to perform at your best.

• Clear, Accelerated Career Progression: Defined pathways to leadership and specialist roles within Ebury.

• Dynamic & Supportive Culture: Work in a collaborative environment where teamwork and personal growth are prioritized.

• Generous Benefits Package: Access competitive benefits tailored to your location, which typically include health care and social benefits.

• Central Office: A fantastic location with excellent transport links.

jobs.title: Sr. Hardware Technician, PWT
jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Position Overview

We are currently seeking a Sr. Hardware Technician, PWT, as part of product engineering organization in the plant. The candidate will work with multi-disciplinary teams to drive product/specification related investigations to resolution for the products in production. Our ideal candidate exhibits a can-do attitude and approaches their work with vigor and determination. Candidate will be expected to demonstrate excellence in their respective fields, to possess the ability to learn quickly and to strive for impactful results in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

•    Supports component/system/vehicle level troubleshooting using standard communication/diagnostic tools (Canalyzer/Canape, etc.)/RCA test benches
•    Supports RCA of complex component/system level problems using standard problem-solving techniques
•    Supports lineside trials to verify process/equipment compatibility & RCA activities
•    Responsible for board level preliminary PCBA board analysis
•    Supports audits against design intent assembly requirements of Drive Unit beyond control plan
•    Execute prototype builds, trials, troubleshooting, & RCA of product/multi-variable issues in close collaboration with Engineers on the team
•    Support vehicle upfits & tests on as needed basis in close collaboration with Engineers on the team

Skills

•    Good functional understanding of all the systems in EV Powertrain
•    Possess strong interpersonal and teamwork skills to work effectively with team members at all levels.
•    Experience in building, testing, and troubleshooting HV battery pack, Drive Units, & Power Electronics Components
•    Working understanding basic electrical principles.
•    Strong understanding on proper handling of Battery Cells, Modules, Packs, Power Electronics, & Drive unit.
•    Familiar with electrical hazard risks including high voltage systems.
•    Can interpret schematics to help understand the function & interfaces of Power Electronics components
•    Proficient in use of tools to perform teardown of electrical systems.
•    Good with vehicle level troubleshooting for powertrain related faults using standard OBD diagnostic tools.
•    Good with basic machining operations and can read drawings
•    Exceptional written and oral communication skills (English).
•    Can lift 20-30 pounds regularly and up to 50 pounds with via team-lift.

Minimum Qualifications

•    High School Diploma with significant relevant professional experience.
•    Preferred: Technical or Vocational Degree or Certificate.
•    Minimum of 5 years of electrical, mechatronic, or automotive technician experience.
•    Experience using vehicle & system level communication or diagnostic tools for troubleshooting multi-variable complex issues
•    Experience troubleshooting power electronics components/assemblies at the PCBA board level
•    Awareness of HV Battery Packs, HV Harnesses, Onboard charging unit, Drive Unit, Inverter Power Electronics & associated troubleshooting at the system & product level
•    Prior Experience working with High Voltage environment

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations.

Accessibility: Lucid Motors is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need any accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at TA-Operations <@> lucidmotors.com. This email address is designated solely for accommodation requests and is not monitored for job applications or resume submissions. To be considered for employment, all applications must be submitted through the Lucid Motors Careers website.

Candidate Data Privacy: By submitting your application, you understand and agree that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice.
