ABOUT THE LUCAS MUSEUM OF NARRATIVE ART
Opening in September 2026, the Lucas Museum of Narrative Art is dedicated to illustrated storytelling.  Founded by George Lucas and Mellody Hobson, the museum’s collection features works by artists including Norman Rockwell, Kadir Nelson, Jessie Willcox Smith, N. C. Wyeth, Beatrix Potter, Judith F. Baca, Frida Kahlo, and Maxfield Parrish; as well as comic art legends such as Winsor McCay, Jack Kirby, Frank Frazetta, Alison Bechdel, Chris Ware, and R. Crumb; and photographers Gordon Parks, Henri Cartier-Bresson, and Dorothea Lange. The Museum also houses the Lucas Archives, containing models, props, concept art, and costumes from Lucas’s filmmaking career. 
 
Designed by Ma Yansong of MAD with a landscape by Mia Lehrer of Studio-MLA, the Museum is in Exposition Park, Los Angeles, on an 11-acre campus that includes new green space and a 300,000-square-foot building with galleries, two theaters, a library, restaurant, café, retail store, and community spaces.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Network & Supply Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Lisbon, Portugal

About the role

Cloudflare is scaling one of the largest global networks on the Internet, and capacity planning is what keeps that growth ahead of demand. As an Infrastructure Network & Supply Planner on our Infrastructure Capacity Planning team you'll build the products, tools, and AI agents that turn growth and demand forecasts into scalable, execution-ready infrastructure expansions, ensuring the right capacity is in the right place, at the right time and cost, in the shortest time possible.

You'll design and ship internal products — forecasting models, planning systems, dashboards, and automated workflows — that make end-to-end infrastructure readiness faster, cheaper, and more reliable at global scale

You'll refine and create new AI agents to model demand into supply, network, and capacity scenarios and surface risks early, producing force multipliers that let planners see the whole system and act quickly — shifting time from reactive task-processing to proactive strategy, and scaling impact. You'll partner across planning, operations, procurement, logistics, engineering, and finance to keep Cloudflare's global deployments moving smoothly.

What you'll do

Infrastructure Capacity & Expansion Planning

• Translate demand forecasts into infrastructure capacity plans that support business growth, aligning hardware deployments with performance, cost, and timeline targets.

• Ensure infrastructure readiness across space, power, connectivity, and hardware availability, identifying capacity constraints early and coordinating mitigation.

Deployment Planning & Execution Coordination

• Build quarterly and weekly deployment plans that are realistic, balanced, and optimized for execution efficiency across operations, logistics, integration partners, and engineering teams.

• Track progress, resolve blockers, and maintain deployment momentum across the global fleet.

Supply, Inventory & Lifecycle Readiness

• Partner with Procurement and Data Center teams to ensure hardware and resources are available at the right time and locations, and manage inventory to balance availability, cost efficiency, and operational risk.

• Support hardware refresh and asset lifecycle planning, and align infrastructure investments with budget and growth plans alongside Finance.

AI-First Products, Automation & Continuous Improvement

• Design, build, and ship internal products — forecasting models, dashboards, planning systems, and automated workflows — using AI/agentic tooling to structure messy data, run scenario analyses, and improve planning accuracy.

• Identify high-leverage opportunities to automate repetitive work, introduce new tools and methodologies, and continuously improve how planning and deployment operate at scale.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Act as a central layer across planning, operations, engineering, logistics, procurement, and finance to keep Cloudflare's global deployments moving smoothly.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

• Experience in capacity planning, infrastructure planning, production/operations planning, supply planning, or a related technical planning role.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience across complex operational systems and managing multiple priorities in fast-paced environments.

• Hands-on experience building tools, automation, or internal products

• Fluency with AI tools in daily work, and a genuine appetite to use and create AI/agentic tooling to scale decision-making and eliminate manual toil.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

• For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary of €36,000-50,000.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

jobs.title: Senior Market Intelligence Specialist
jobs.location: Espoo, FI / München, DE / Milan, IT / Madrid, ES / Warsaw, PL
jobs.description:
At IQM, we build world-leading quantum computers for the well-being of humankind. We design systems to tackle computational challenges beyond the practical limits of classical machines. Our work sits at the edge of science and engineering. It's complex, demanding, and deeply collaborative. We turn deep research into reliable, full-stack systems that drive discoveries in fields like medicine, energy, and technology, reshaping how the world computes.

Join the team that gives quantum a heartbeat.

The work

As a Senior Market Intelligence Specialist, you'll be the person who keeps that foundation solid. You'll turn raw market data into insight our sales, marketing, and leadership teams can actually use and trust. Every figure you touch will be accurate, current, and traceable back to a credible source. You'll work closely with the Market Intelligence & Strategy Manager and partner regularly with sales, marketing, and technology teams across the business.

What you’ll actually do

• Keep sales collateral up to date with accurate, current market data, with every figure traceable to a credible source
• Support market analysis and forecasting, including sizing, segmentation, and scenario work across quantum computing markets
• Maintain existing economic impact and market forecast models used by the commercial team
• Monitor and maintain market intelligence databases, and keep scouting for better or additional sources
• Build and grow relationships with analysts at quantum market intelligence firms to keep IQM close to the latest research
• Work cross functionally with business and technology teams, turning their questions into clear intelligence
• Communicate findings through well-structured Excel models and PowerPoint outputs for commercial and executive audiences
• Bring judgment to ambiguous, fast-moving questions, and deliver reliable output with limited supervision

What we’re looking for

• Master's degree in Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business, or a related field
• Experience in market intelligence, market research, strategy, or a similar analytical role
• Strong skills in market research, sizing, segmentation, and forecasting
• Excellent Excel skills, including structuring data, building models, and quality checking figures
• Strong PowerPoint skills, with the ability to communicate findings clearly to different audiences
• High numeracy, with good judgment on data quality and methodology
• Comfortable working independently and managing priorities in a fast-moving, deep tech environment

Seen as an advantage

• Experience working with or alongside industry analyst firms as an in-house analyst for your organization (for example IDC, The Quantum Insider, or Gartner)

Why IQM?

• Full-stack quantum computing: From quantum hardware to software layers and beyond, we build across the full-stack.
• High-performance playground: We aim high, and we know sustainable performance only works when life outside work does too—hybrid setups, flexible hours.
• Never the smartest: You won’t always be the smartest person in the room. Neither will we. Expect to learn constantly - from each other and beyond with IQM’s Learning Hub, LinkedIn Learning, and a team-based L&D budget.
• Approachable leadership: Flat hierarchy, direct access. Feel free to approach any leaders. They're friendlier than they look!

jobs.title: Sr. Mechanical Engineer, Stator/Rotor
jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Position Overview

We are currently seeking a Mechanical Engineer II, Stator/Rotor as part of resident product engineering organization in the plant. Our ideal candidate exhibits a can-do attitude and approaches their work with vigor, determination, & leads by example. Candidate will be expected to demonstrate excellence in their respective fields, to possess the ability to lead the team through technical & organizational challenges to deliver impactful results in an ambiguous environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Solve complex component/system level problems using standard problem-solving techniques

• Data driven proactive problem solving, root cause analysis & issue avoidance due to process deviations or critical part quality issues

• Establish technical depth to troubleshoot Stator & Rotor sub-assemblies & its interface with manufacturing process & associated equipment related variables

• Responsible for design intent assembly requirements for Stator & Rotor, associated enforcement on the line in close collaboration with cross-functional teams

• Responsible for setting up process flow & implementation of assembly drawings covering product specifications relevant to manufacturing

• Support prototype builds to verify product compatibility against MFG process/equipment

• Support new product launches, execute part concession deviations for E-Motor assembly in the manufacturing plant

• Support high volume production ramp activities pertaining to product engineering activities

• Advice on build process development and possible improvements for high volume production lines

• Lead product change management to address known product compatibility issues for high volume production or known product design issues in production in close collaboration with cross-functional teams where appropriate

• Evaluate Cp, Cpk, Pp, Ppk, control charts, distribution behavior, and correlation between process parameters and product performance.

• Provide plant feedback to product design teams and recommend design changes that improve manufacturability, quality, serviceability, and production robustness

• Lead technical discussions involving Product Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Supplier Quality, Production, Maintenance, Controls, and Equipment Engineering

• Provide technical mentoring to technicians, production associates, and less-experienced engineers

• Ensure lessons learned are incorporated into current improvement plans and future product designs, process standards, and equipment specifications

Skills

•    BS in Mechanical or Automotive Engineering disciplines with 4+ years of automotive experience in design and release of vehicle attributes.
•    Master’s degree in mechanical or automotive disciplines with 2+ years of automotive experience in design & release of vehicle attributes
•    Experience in product problem solving using industry standard techniques
•    Excellent in data analysis using statistics Minitab or JMP, Python, MATLAB
•    Prior experience working in resident product engineering roles in the plant
•    Technical awareness in stator & rotor subassemblies with associated troubleshooting is required
•    Prior Experience in product development or improvement of Stator/Rotor assemblies
•    Understanding of critical elements of stator and rotor such as lamination stacks, insulation materials, windings, forming, welding end-of-line electrical testing, press-fit, etc and their impact on part quality
•    Experience in using DFMEA, PFMEA, Control Plan, DVP&R, DFM/DFA, & RCA with cross-functional teams
•    Exceptional communication and documentation skills are required using Atlassian products.
•    Requires proficiency in Catia or 3DX, Stack up analysis (2D & 3D), SQL, JMP etc.,)
•    Experience with CAD IN 3DEXPERIENCE.
•    Six Sigma Green certification.
•    Experience with Atlassian products like Jira and Confluence.
•    Engineering-in-Training (EIT) or certification in engineering fundamentals.
•    Collegiate FSAE/BAJA/Similar experience is preferred

Minimum Qualifications

• BS in Mechanical or Automotive Engineering disciplines with 4+ years of automotive experience in design and release of vehicle attributes.

• Experience in product problem solving using industry standard techniques

• Prior experience working in resident product engineering roles in the plant

• Technical awareness in stator & rotor subassemblies with associated troubleshooting is required

• Prior Experience in product development or improvement of Stator/Rotor assemblies

• Exceptional communication and documentation skills are required

• Requires proficiency in Catia or 3DX, Stack up analysis (2D & 3D), SQL, JMP etc.,)

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Role

Serve as the on-duty commander for Alpaca's most critical incidents, directing cross-functional response to restore service quickly, keeping the right people engaged and informed, and making sure every incident leaves behind something the organisation can act on.

You do not fix the outage. You make the response reliable: correct severity, the right engineers in the room, mitigation that does not stall, leaders informed in time, and follow-up work that survives the call.

Things You Get To Do

• Command incidents end to end. Take command from declaration to mitigation, keeping responders focused on stopping customer and partner impact as fast as possible. Run the bridge, keep observers out of the responders' way, and name a stall out loud when you see one.

• Classify and hold the line on severity. Set severity at declaration and re-check it as facts arrive. Risk advises on financial and regulatory materiality; the call is yours.

• Engage the right people, fast. Identify the owning team by service, symptom and blast radius, page them, and expand the responder set the moment the first team is wrong or not enough. When a page goes unanswered, escalate - and escalate the escalation. Bring in the leaders who must make business calls: feature flags, traffic shedding, failover, freeze-or-ship.

• Hold the bridge, and protect the people fixing it. Keep engineering and technical support uninterrupted - questions from stakeholders, partners and executives come to you. Be the single source of truth to the partner communications team on impact, severity and timing: you decide when a status page update or partner contact is needed, they write and send it, and chasing a late or stale update is yours.

• Run follow-the-sun handoffs. Deliver warm, high-fidelity handoffs across regions: current impact and severity, mitigation path and next actions, who is in the room, outstanding decisions, and what must not be dropped. The incoming commander confirms ownership before you step away - command never goes dark at a region boundary.

• Close the loop, on the clock. Maintain the timeline of facts as the incident runs rather than reconstructing it afterwards - in a regulated business that record has to hold up long after the call ends. Once mitigated, make sure a blameless retrospective is scheduled with a named owner and a timebox, and record where the cause sits - that choice sets which follow-up items are mandatory. Every action item needs a real ticket, one named accountable, a priority and a category, delivered inside the agreed service level. If a postmortem produces nothing but low-priority items, treat that as a signal the analysis stopped early and escalate to SRE rather than passing it on.

• Automate the coordination away. Coordination is the part of this job that should eventually belong to a machine. Every manual prompt you send - the update that is due, the question nobody answered, the partner nobody contacted - is a candidate for automation, and the direction we are heading is AI handling the routine so commanders can spend their attention on judgement. You get us there by working to the decision trees, saying where they are wrong, and being honest about which of your instincts are actually rules.

Who You Are (Must-Haves)

• 4+ years commanding or co-commanding high-severity incidents in a production engineering, SRE or technical operations environment.

• You direct technical responders under pressure without being the person writing the fix.

• You make and defend crisp severity and escalation decisions, and you take charge without waiting to be asked. Command means waking senior people at 03:00, interrupting an executive, and telling an experienced engineer to stop what they are doing - with an audience watching. It is a visible, directive role and it needs to be instinctive.

• You can read a dashboard and judge for yourself whether impact has actually stopped.

• You communicate clearly with engineers, executives and partner-facing stakeholders - and you know the difference between briefing the comms function and speaking for the company.

• You are comfortable holding other teams to account in the moment, across a reporting line that is not yours, without turning it into friction.

• You thrive in a follow-the-sun model with clean cross-region handoffs.

• You understand FinTech concepts and the trust stakes of API-driven financial platforms.

• You use AI tools and agentic automation to reduce manual toil and speed up response.

• You will work a regional coverage window as part of a global 24x7 Incident Commander roster.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves)

• Formal incident command training - ITIL, Major Incident Management or crisis management.

• Experience with modern incident management and on-call platforms.

• You have written severity rubrics, decision trees, escalation matrices, runbooks or incident playbooks.

• You have commanded in game days, tabletop exercises or incident simulations, not only in production.

• You have partnered with problem management or reliability programme functions to roadmap incident follow-ups.

• Online securities trading or capital markets experience, or another regulated, market-hours-sensitive domain.

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Success in this role comes from your ability to strategically identify and engage potential clients, uncover their key business challenges, and align Toptal’s solutions to meet their needs. Drive full-cycle sales by identifying and engaging high-potential prospects, re-engaging dormant clients, and generating new opportunities through strategic outreach.
Conduct outbound prospecting via phone, email, and LinkedIn to identify opportunities, present Toptal’s value proposition, and secure new business.
Effectively manage the sales funnel to optimize lead progression, coordinate communication among various stakeholders, and diligently follow up on accounts to nurture leads toward conversion.
Ensure timely and accurate CRM documentation, while providing leadership with clear sales forecasts and pipeline insights.
As you become more comfortable in the role, contribute to evolving our demand generation strategy and tactics to expand pipeline growth and market reach.
In the first week, expect to:
Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.
Work with cross-functional teams to understand how you can utilize our incredible global team to build client relationships and drive success.
Learn the breadth of Toptal’s impact on the world’s largest companies.
Grasp the importance of the outbound function to the success of growing Toptal.
Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success.
In the first month, expect to:
Complete our personalized sales training program, complete with mock calls, cold calls, and role-play scenarios.
Learn how to use outreach tools (SalesLoft, Zoominfo, SalesNavigator).
Learn the process for outreach, including calling, emailing, and LinkedIn messaging. Implement an outreach process and hit 1-month objectives.
Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers.
In the first three months, expect to:
Uncover new opportunities with existing accounts and target accounts that result in revenue-generating engagements for Toptal.
Hit call/email quotas and fully ramped objectives.
Become proficient in using our SaaS tools.
Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com.
In the first six months, expect to:
Continuously hit fully ramped quotas and objectives.
Assist with training and onboarding new Account Executives.
Build new and existing client relationships, expand Toptal’s partnership with new and existing clients.
Suggest, implement and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities.
In the first year, expect to:
Have closed multiple net new accounts from the strategic account list, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and how proper business development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue.
Consistently maintain a high level of success by meeting and exceeding 100% of monthly and quarterly key performance indicators and targets.
Establish a career path for advancement.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree is required.
Minimum 2 years sales experience, including at least 1 year in a closing role.
Experience in B2B or SaaS sales is strongly preferred.
Proven success in full-cycle sales, including lead generation, prospecting, running virtual sales calls, funnel management, and closing.
Proficient with sales tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator, with a demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technologies and adapt to evolving sales platforms.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You’re persistent in the face of setbacks, eager to understand people and problems, and motivated to go above and beyond to reach your goals.
You thrive with autonomy and ownership. We’re looking for someone who can be held accountable for leading their portion of the business.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.
Essential Job Functions
Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
Work independently with minimal supervision.
Use all required digital collaboration tools.
Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.
US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt
This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to earn monthly commissions based on revenue generated from engagements sold. For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.

jobs.description:

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Quality TL is responsible for leading daily vehicle inspection and quality verification activities within the Customer Acceptance Line, ensuring all vehicles meet defined customer acceptance
standards, quality specifications, and regulatory requirements prior to release. The role provides frontline leadership to Quality Inspectors, coordinates inspection activities, drives rapid
containment and escalation of quality concerns, and ensures accurate documentation of inspection results.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead by example through strict adherence to all Environmental Health and Safety requirements, including mandatory PPE usage based on workstation requirements.

• Monitor, contain, and escalate recurrent, critical, or customer-impacting quality issues in accordance with escalation and reactivity procedures.

• Secure quality escapes to Vehicle Audit / LCPA by ensuring robust containment, defect confirmation, and calibration of team members against standards.

• Provide structured feedback to Manufacturing, Quality Engineering, and cross-functional partners on repetitive quality issues and verify containment and corrective action effectiveness.

• Drive continuous improvement in defect detection, process robustness, and inspection effectiveness using audit results, lessons learned, and field quality feedback.

• Ensure proper use, availability, maintenance, and calibration status of inspection tools,gauges, and equipment according to defined planning.

• Train, coach, and support inspectors and new hires on inspection methods, safety requirements, standards, and acceptance criteria.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Lighting Systems
jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Position Overview

The Staff Engineer, Lighting Systems (Resident Engineering) will serve as the primary on-site technical owner for plant-related lighting topics, supporting launch readiness, production stabilization, issue resolution, and continuous improvement across lighting systems. This role requires a hands-on engineer with a strong combination of mechanical design, hardware integration, supplier coordination, validation, and manufacturing support skills. The ideal candidate will operate with high ownership, urgency, and accountability to ensure lighting components meet engineering requirements, plant build requirements, quality expectations, and program milestones.

Key Responsibilities

•    Act as the on-site technical owner for lighting systems during prototype builds, launch, ramp-up, and production stabilization.
•    Own plant-related lighting topics, including fit, function, packaging, sealing, mounting, assembly feasibility, end-of-line issues, and vehicle-level integration concerns.
•    Act as the primary technical liaison between AMP-2 KSA, global lighting engineering teams (Europe and North America), suppliers, and manufacturing organizations to ensure alignment on technical issues, priorities, launch readiness, and execution.
•    Lead root cause analysis for lighting concerns identified during builds, launch, production, validation, or field feedback, and coordinate containment and corrective action plans
•    Support mechanical and hardware troubleshooting for lighting modules, including brackets, housing, lenses, connectors, PCBs, light guides, harness interfaces, electronic control units, and mounting features.
•    Review and interpret CAD data, 2D drawings, GD&T, specifications, EBOMs, release documentation, DFMEA PFMEA, DVP&Rs, and supplier technical documents to support plant execution.
•    Coordinate engineering changes, deviations, temporary approvals, build concerns, and design improvements needed to support production readiness and program timing.
•    Participate in line trials, build events, quality reviews, launch meetings, supplier reviews, and vehicle-level issue resolution activities.
•    Work with suppliers and internal teams to validate corrected parts, confirm design intent, and ensure readiness for continued production use.
•    Track open lighting issues, owners, timing, risk level, containment status, and permanent corrective actions to ensure transparent execution.
•    Provide clear written and verbal updates to leadership on issue status, technical risk, launch readiness, and escalation needs.
•    Identify and escalate program risks early, providing clear technical recommendations and recovery plans for leadership.
•    Lead sustaining product improvement activities for lighting systems where appropriate with close collaboration with teams in HQ.

Skills

•    Strong lighting systems development capability, with demonstrated understanding of concept development, design release, validation, tooling, launch readiness, and serial production support.
•    Mechanical engineering skill set required to evaluate plastics, injection molding, sealing strategy, thermal considerations, assembly feasibility, mounting concepts, tolerance management, and vehicle-level packaging.
•    Ability to work across lighting hardware and electrical interfaces, including PCBs, connectors, LED drivers, wiring, control units, diagnostics, functional behavior of lighting devices, basic EE components, and double-sourcing considerations.
•    Problem-solving skills required to support root cause analysis, containment, corrective actions, validation of fixes, and production issue resolution in a launch or manufacturing environment.
•    Technical proficiency with CATIA or 3DX, GD&T, 2D and 3D stack-up analysis, SQL, CANalyzer, and the ability to read and interpret CAD models, engineering drawings, technical specifications, DFMEA, DVP&R, and supplier documentation.
•    Collaboration skills required to work directly with plant teams, quality, manufacturing, suppliers, and global engineering teams in a fast-paced launch and production environment.
•    Strong organizational and execution skills, including the ability to track multiple open issues, drive ownership, communicate status clearly, and maintain visibility to timing, risk, containment, and permanent corrective actions.
•    Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and engineering issue-tracking tools required to manage launch, quality, validation, and production readiness activities.
•    Hands-on capability to reflash PCBAs and support software or calibration updates required for lighting module troubleshooting and validation.
•    Hands-on capability to operate electrical measurement equipment, including multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, and related tools used to diagnose lighting hardware and EE component concerns.
•    Understanding of end-of-line requirements, specifications, and validation activities required for production readiness, including headlamp aiming and related lighting checks.
•    Working knowledge of lighting homologation and regulatory requirements relevant to the position, including FMVSS 108, ECE R48, ECE R149, and GB 4785.

Minimum Qualifications

•    Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or related technical field required.
•    10+ years of automotive OEM or Tier 1 experience in lighting systems, resident engineering, launch, manufacturing support, or production issue resolution.
•    Experience with automotive lighting development, validation, launch, plant support, quality concerns, and sustaining improvements.
•    Ability to read and evaluate CAD models, 2D drawings, GD&T, specifications, and release documentation using CATIA, 3DX, or equivalent tools.
•    Ability to support plant builds, supplier visits, line trials, issue investigations, validation activities, and launch-critical events.
•    Strong communication and ownership to align cross-functional teams, drive issue closure, and manage timing, risk, containment, and corrective actions.

Success Profile

A successful Staff Engineer, Lighting Systems as part of Resident Engineering team is hands-on, structured, and highly accountable. This person can move quickly between plant floor concerns and engineering-level problem solving, translating technical issues into clear actions with owners, timing, and risk visibility. The role is best suited for an engineer who can combine mechanical judgment, hardware understanding, supplier coordination, and launch discipline to protect program’s milestones and ensure lighting systems are successfully integrated into production.

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Writer - Customer Onboarding
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We are looking for a Principal Technical Writer to lead the strategy and execution of our customer onboarding and 'Getting Started' content. Your mission is to transform our onboarding materials into a cohesive, narrative-driven experience that guides users to their first 'aha!' moment. You will partner closely with the Self-Service (SSC) team, acting as a bridge between the field, product, and documentation to ensure our content is not just accurate, but effective at guiding trial-to-paid conversion. In this role, you will define the narrative architecture of our user journey, ensuring that every touchpoint, from first-time setup to advanced feature adoption, feels like a seamless, intentional story. You'll be the champion of the new-user experience, working in lockstep with others to turn technical capability into user success.

What You Will Be Doing

• Drive the onboarding content strategy. Define and execute a cohesive narrative for how users learn to use our products, ensuring a seamless story from the first visit to successful deployment.

• Align Field, Product, and Docs. Act as a central point of contact for stakeholders. Work with Product teams to understand roadmap changes, Field teams to identify friction points in real-world deployments, and Documentation teams to ensure high-quality content output.

• Design user-focused flows. Create organized onboarding experiences. These should highlight best practices, troubleshooting, and clear next steps. Avoid confusing 'choose-your-own-adventure' methods.

• Measure and Iterate. Use user research, support feedback, and telemetry to identify where users stall and iterate on content to reduce churn and improve time-to-first-value.

What You Bring

• 7+ years of relevant experience. Experience in technical writing or developer-focused roles, with a proven track record in onboarding or user journey design.

• Cross-functional leadership. Proven ability to lead initiatives and influence stakeholders across product, engineering, and sales/field organizations.

• Deep narrative skills. Experience in creating compelling, cohesive stories for complex technical products.

• Data-driven mindset. Comfortable using analytics, UXR, and support data to inform documentation decisions and prioritize work.

• Collaborative spirit. Experience working in large, distributed organizations where alignment across multiple teams is critical to success.

• Customer knowledge. Experience with self-service cloud products as a user or practitioner, with an understanding of how customers onboard, evaluate, and adopt technical tools.

Our docs team helps shape the evolution of our products and services. We care deeply about giving you ownership of what you’re working on. We believe Elastic achieves greatness when you are free to pursue your ideas and are surrounded and challenged by your peers.

Position Summary

The Spa Head Therapist / Trainer is responsible for delivering exceptional spa treatments while leading, coaching, and developing the spa team to ensure the highest standards of service, treatment quality, guest satisfaction, and operational excellence.

The role serves as the primary trainer and mentor for all therapists, ensuring adherence to brand standards, treatment protocols, product knowledge, retail sales techniques, and wellness service delivery. The Spa Head Therapist / Trainer supports the Spa Director and Spa Manager in achieving financial targets, maintaining operational efficiency, and creating memorable guest experiences.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Leadership & Team Development

• Lead and motivate the therapist team through daily supervision and coaching.
• Conduct departmental orientation for new team members.
• Prepare departmental training plan/ training schedule/ training report
• Develop and implement daily/ weekly and monthly training plans for therapists.
• Deliver practical and theoretical training on treatments, products, workshops, wellness programs, and guest service standards.
• Conduct regular treatment assessments and competency evaluations.
• Monitor therapist performance and provide constructive feedback.
• Assist management with performance reviews and development plans.
• Foster a positive and professional team culture.

Guest Experience & Treatment Delivery

• Deliver spa treatments according to established SOPs and luxury service standards.
• Perform treatments based on guest consultation and health assessment.
• Ensure all guest interactions exceed expectations and reflect the resort's service culture.
• Handle guest concerns and recovery situations professionally.
• Maintain confidentiality of guest information and treatment records.
• Encourage repeat business through exceptional service and personalized recommendations.

• Deliver exceptional, warm, and intuitive service at all times
• Actively engage with guests to understand their wellness needs and recommend suitable classes or spa treatments
• Promote wellness programs, classes, and spa offerings
• Create a calming, welcoming atmosphere reflective of a luxury spa environment

Training & Quality Assurance

• Ensure consistency of treatment standards across all therapists.
• Conduct regular treatment audits and quality assessments.
• Maintain up-to-date training records and competency metrics
• Train therapists on new treatments, techniques, seasonal promotions, and wellness programs.
• Ensure adherence to brand standards, operational procedures, and treatment protocols.
• Monitor grooming, hygiene, and professional presentation standards.

Financial Performance and Retail Sales

• Support achievement of departmental revenue targets.
• Promote and drive retail sales through effective product recommendations.
• Encourage treatment upgrades and wellness program sales.
• Monitor therapist productivity and utilization.
• Assist with inventory control and product cost management.
• Support monthly stock counts and inventory reconciliation.

Spa Operations

• Assist with daily scheduling and therapist allocations.
• Ensure treatment rooms are properly prepared and maintained.
• Ensure daily requirements stocks are maintained (Dry amenities, disposables, shower amenities, fruits, store items, cleaning items etc.)
• Monitor equipment functionality and report maintenance requirements.
• Support spa opening/closing/ set-up when required
• Ensure cleanliness and presentation standards throughout the spa.
• Assist with operational reports and administrative duties.

Policies and Procedures

• Maintains a high standard of appearance and grooming at all times, as per Raffles Standard.
• Apply and adhere to rules and regulations as per standard handbook, departmental and Resort policies and procedures, including those for the emergency situations
• Develop and maintain an understanding of the overall organization’s mission, vision and values
• Handles any guest’s complaint in a professional manner, as per standard Policy & Procedures
• Practices proper telephone etiquette with colleagues and resort guests.
• Ensures all activities are carried out honestly, ethically and within the parameters of the Seychellois Law

Health, Safety & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with all health, safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards.
• Maintain awareness of emergency procedures and resort policies.
• Ensure therapists follow safe treatment practices at all times.
• Report and address any potential workplace hazards.
• Lead by example in maintaining professional conduct and ethical standards.

Key Performance Indictaors (KPIs)

• Guest Satisfaction Score
• Therapist Productivity %
• Retail Revenue Achievement
• Treatment Revenue Achievement
• Training Hours Delivered
• Repeat Guest Ratio
• Treatment Audit Results
• Inventory Management
• Employee Engagement and Retention

Skills & Competencies

• Advanced knowledge of massage therapies, body treatments, facials, and any related wellness therapies.
• Strong training, coaching, and mentoring skills.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
• Strong retail sales and guest engagement skills.
• Leadership and team management capability.
• Computer literacy and spa software knowledge.
• Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage

Job Qualifications

• Diploma or Certification in Spa Therapy, Massage Therapy, Beauty Therapy, or Wellness Management.
• Minimum 3 years of experience as a Spa Therapist in a luxury spa environment.
• Minimum 1 year experience in a supervisory, lead therapist, or trainer role preferred.

jobs.title: Ведущий специалист по планированию производства
jobs.description:
Цель должности (Role Purpose)

Старший специалист по планированию производства обеспечивает синхронизацию производственной стратегии и мощностей с долгосрочными бизнес-целями компании. Сотрудник управляет производственными графиками для обеспечения своевременного выпуска продукции, соблюдая баланс между клиентским спросом и доступными ресурсами.

Ключевые обязанности включают разработку детализированных производственных планов, координацию межфункциональных рабочих процессов (закупки, планирование материалов), оперативное устранение сбоев в производстве для достижения целевых показателей по себестоимости и срокам поставки, а также инициирование улучшений в процессах. К стратегическим задачам относятся: балансировка производственных мощностей, повышение операционной эффективности и удовлетворение потребностей клиентов в части своевременности производства.

Ключевые зоны ответственности (Key Accountabilities)

В рамках поддержки региональной и глобальной стратегии FF&P (формуляция, фасовка и упаковка), бизнес-приоритетов и бюджетных показателей

• Реализация стратегии (Strategy deployment): Разработка и согласование стратегий планирования и производства для достижения бизнес-целей; обеспечение гибкости и надежности производства для адаптации к росту и волатильности рынка, обеспечение непрерывности бизнеса и эффективности в части постоянных и переменных затрат.
• Планирование (Scheduling): Разработка детализированных ежедневных, еженедельных и ежемесячных производственных планов и графиков для удовлетворения клиентского спроса. Своевременное и проактивное размещение, актуализация и мониторинг производственных заказов в системе SAP.
• Управление запасами (Inventory Control): В тесном взаимодействии с отделом планирования материалов — мониторинг уровней сырья и складских остатков для предотвращения дефицита, избыточных запасов или задержек в производстве.
• Координация (Coordination): Взаимодействие с командами по закупкам, планированию и производству для обеспечения бесперебойной и эффективной операционной деятельности. Выполнение функций ключевого связующего звена между локальным подразделением и региональной командой FF&P.
• Оптимизация (Optimization): Выявление возможностей для снижения затрат, совершенствования процессов и сокращения производственных потерь.
• Решение проблем (Troubleshooting): Устранение «узких мест» в производстве, сбоев в работе оборудования или непредвиденных задержек.
• Отчетность (Reporting): Отслеживание KPI и предоставление руководству отчетов о ходе производства, показателях эффективности и возникающих проблемах.
• Финансовый контроль (Financial Controlling): Мониторинг поступления готовой продукции в системе SAP и обработка закрывающих документов, предоставляемых производством. Обеспечение и контроль взаиморасчетов с производственными площадками за оказанные услуги.

Ключевые точки интеграции (Key Integration Points):

• MM (Materials Management): Закупки сырья и материалов.
• SD (Sales and Distribution): Прогноз продаж/план поставок.
• CO (Controlling): Расчет себестоимости продукции.

Ключевые показатели эффективности (Key Performance Metrics):

• Процент своевременных поставок (On-time delivery, OTD).
• Соблюдение производственного графика (Production schedule adherence).
• Снижение операционных затрат (Operational cost reduction).
• Коэффициент использования мощностей (Capacity utilization).

Критически важный опыт (Critical Experience)

• Значительный опыт в производственном планировании — минимум 5 лет в планировании производства или производственной деятельности, подтвержденный опыт в планировании производства, составлении графиков или управлении запасами в производственной среде

The B2B Digital Marketing team sits within Agoda’s B2B Marketing organization and is responsible for delivering high‑quality, scalable marketing campaigns for our partners across B2B2C channels. Our mission is to balance operational excellence with growth impact — building repeatable, scalable frameworks that allow us to support dozens of partners at once, while still delivering insights tailored to each partner’s performance and business context.

• Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to work independently

• Experience in digital marketing or ecommerce

• Experience with A/B testing and other testing metrics

• Strong presentation and negotiation skills

• Skills that foster collaboration and team spirit

jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About the opportunity

Within Booking Holdings, an enhanced and more connected B2B business is being built within Booking Holdings consolidating the businesses of Booking.com, Priceline and Agoda into a single global division (“New B2B Business”)

About the role

In this role, you will shape pricing and commercial strategies for partner opportunities, advise stakeholders on trade-offs, and drive value through execution and experimentation. You will work across Commercial, Product, Data Science, Marketing, and partner-facing teams, often in situations where alignment matters as much as the analysis itself.

What you'll do

• Own and evolve pricing strategies and optimization for B2B partner channels.

• Build and lead experimentation roadmaps, including test design, success measures, decision frameworks, and post-test actions.

• Evaluate pricing and growth opportunities through structured analysis, including elasticity, incrementality, cannibalization, and scenario modeling where relevant.

• Act as a trusted advisor to senior internal and external stakeholders; surface trade-offs, align priorities, and drive decisions to closure; Coordinate cross-functional execution across Commercial, Product, Data Science, Marketing, and operations teams.

• Turn complex findings into concise executive narratives, recommendations, and decision-ready materials; Manage strategic partner and vendor interactions when required, including presentations, working sessions, and follow-ups.

What you'll bring

• Experience applying quantitative analysis to commercial decisions in technology, e-commerce, travel, management consulting, internal strategy, or pricing.

• Strong business judgment and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to frame ambiguous questions, evaluate trade-offs, and recommend a path forward.

• Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to influence without authority and build alignment across functions, seniority levels, and geographies.

• Fluency with data and analytical tools, including advanced SQL; experience with visualization tools such as Tableau or an equivalent platform.

• Practical experience designing or interpreting controlled experiments and translating results into decisions.

• A high-ownership, bias-for-action mindset and comfort operating in a fast-paced, test-and-learn environment.

• A bachelor's degree in a quantitative, business, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

It's a plus if you have

• A background in using quantitative data for decision making within tech, ecommerce , management consulting, internal strategy, or pricing initiatives

• Experience building decision frameworks or analytical tools that are used repeatedly in live business decisions.

• Working knowledge of Python or R for modeling and scalable analysis.

What success looks like

• Become a trusted advisor whose recommendations are clear, rigorous, and commercially grounded.

• Turn pricing insights and experiments into decisions and coordinated execution.

• Build alignment across stakeholders, functions, and markets.

• Develop repeatable approaches that can scale across partners.

jobs.title: Laboratory Quality Control Supervisor
jobs.description:
We are now hiring a QC Supervisor to join our team on our site in Cork for a 12 month contract. The QC Supervisor is a key member of the Quality Control team, responsible for leading day-to-day quality control laboratory operations and ensuring effective support for QA, Technical Service, and Production in line with site schedules and targets. This role supervises a team of QC Chemists, reports to the QC Manager, and may act as deputy when required. The position requires strong leadership, technical expertise, and a commitment to compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, company policies, and cGMP standards.

Responsibilities

• Supervise daily QC laboratory operations and ensure work is performed in accordance with regulatory and company requirements.
• Support daily and weekly production schedules, including participation in Tier 1 and Tier 2 meetings.
• Escalate laboratory, safety, equipment, process, and systems issues through the site escalation process as needed.
• Lead, coach, and develop QC staff to build capability, support performance, and strengthen succession planning.
• Ensure adequate laboratory coverage, timely sample management, and support for internal and external testing activities.
• Maintain high standards for documentation, data integrity, and timely completion of required records and reports.
• Oversee laboratory calibration, maintenance, and equipment utilization metrics.
• Deliver or coordinate training to ensure laboratory personnel are qualified, compliant, and effective in their roles.
• Promote cGMP, safety, housekeeping, and security compliance while maintaining a safe working environment.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives, support method and process development, and contribute to scientific studies and laboratory enhancements.

• Bachelor’s degree or higher in Chemistry or a related Science discipline.
• 3–5 years of relevant QC experience, including at least 2 years of direct supervisory experience or demonstrated staff mentoring.
• Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing operations, cGMP requirements, USP, FDA guidance, and QC laboratory practices.
• Experience with analytical instrumentation and laboratory methods such as HPLC, GC, Dissolution, FTIR, UV/Vis, wet chemistry, method validation, method transfer, and compendial verification.
• Proficiency with LIMS, Microsoft Office, TrackWise, EDOCS, and chromatographic software such as Empower, with strong scientific writing and troubleshooting skills.

jobs.title: IQC Inspector 1 - Swing Shift
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position:

The IQC Inspector I is an entry-level quality role primarily responsible for incoming documentation review, material certification verification, ERP transaction processing, and release of incoming material for manufacturing use. This position ensures that incoming material packages meet quality system requirements and maintain accurate records to support traceability and compliance. The position may perform basic visual inspections and limited dimensional verification while developing inspection knowledge and skills.

Essential Job Duties

• Review Certificates of Conformance, test reports, inspection reports, and supplier documentation to verify compliance with purchase order, drawing, and specification requirements.
• Verify completeness and accuracy of incoming material documentation packages.
• Perform material release transactions within SAP or applicable ERP systems.
• Create and maintain inspection history records and electronic quality documentation.
• Ensure traceability information is complete and accurate.
• Process nonconforming material documentation and create quality notifications when required.
• Communicate documentation discrepancies to Quality Engineers, Supplier Quality Engineers, and supervisors.
• Support inventory accuracy and material disposition processes.
• Perform visual inspection of incoming materials and assemblies.
• Conduct basic dimensional verification using standard measuring tools when required.
• Learn blueprint reading and GD&T fundamentals.
• Support quality projects and continuous improvement activities.

Required Education and Training

• High school diploma, A.S. Engineering Degree would be a bonus.
• Related experience or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Working Conditions

• Must be able to remain in a stationary sitting/standing position for extended periods while performing documentation review, material verification, and inspection activities.
• Requires frequent walking between IQC workstations, receiving areas, warehouse locations, and material storage areas.
• Must be able to occasionally lift and move materials weighing up to 45 pounds.
• Frequent use of computers, monitors, keyboards, and barcode scanning equipment.
• Requires visual acuity to review documentation, labels, certifications, part markings, and computer-generated records.
• Work is performed in both office and warehouse environments where temperatures may vary throughout the year and may not always be climate controlled.
• May require bending, reaching, kneeling, and handling containers or materials during receiving and disposition activities.
• Must be able to work safely around material handling equipment, carts, forklifts, and warehouse traffic.
• Use of appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) may be required depending upon task and location.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Experience reviewing manufacturing records or quality documentation.
• Experience with SAP or ERP systems.
• Understanding of traceability requirements.
• Experience within medical device, biotech, aerospace, or regulated manufacturing environments.
• Basic understanding of inspection tools and manufacturing drawings.
• Working knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing..

jobs.title: Application Security Engineer
jobs.description:
NOTE: As part of our hiring process, we conduct background and reference checks at the to validate relevant experience, qualifications, location and professional history.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Application Security Engineer at RootstockLabs, you will help secure our Bitcoin-secured DeFi infrastructure by reviewing code, smart contracts, and protocol changes, and by building the security automation that keeps our development lifecycle safe. You will work closely with development teams on threat modeling and architecture reviews, manage our bug bounty program end to end, and coordinate external security audits with third-party auditors. You will also research attack techniques relevant to our ecosystem (EVM, bridges, p2p) and translate them into concrete defenses, and support incident investigations when application-layer issues arise.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Perform security reviews of source code, smart contracts, and protocol changes across RootstockLabs projects

• Participate in design and architecture reviews; threat-model new products and features with development teams

• Triage and validate bug bounty reports; assess severity and coordinate remediation with engineering

• Collaborate on external security audits: scope engagements and work with third-party auditors through to the resolution of findings

• Build and operate security automation, including AI-assisted code review, scanning, and findings-triage pipelines

• Research attack techniques relevant to the ecosystem (EVM, bridges, p2p) and turn findings into concrete defenses: monitoring alerts, CI security checks, and hardening changes

• Support incident investigations when application-layer issues arise

WHAT YOU BRING

• 3+ years of experience in Application Security or Security Engineering

• Solid grasp of common vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10) and secure code review in Java plus at least one of TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Go, or Rust

• Hands-on experience with blockchain security: smart contract auditing (Solidity/EVM) or protocol/node-level security

• Experience building and operating security automation, AI-assisted workflows (LLM-based triage, code review, or scanning), SAST/DAST, dependency and secret scanning, and CI/CD security gates

• Fluent English

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience in bug bounty triage or vulnerability disclosure programs

• Experience mitigating network-level attacks (p2p, eclipse, DoS) or analyzing consensus-level attack scenarios

• Offensive security background (pentesting, red team, CTFs, exploit development)

• Public security research: CVEs, bug bounty track record, audit reports, conference talks

• Knowledge of C/C++ (for node/client codebases)

• Experience with fuzzing (smart contracts or native code)

ROOTIES BENEFITS

At RootstockLabs, we don’t just offer a job, we offer a community. Here’s what you can expect when you join us:

• Competitive compensation package and unique benefits designed to support your growth and well-being.

• 100% Remote Work working within a Central European to Argentinian time-zone window (UTC-3 to UTC+2, with about an hour's flexibility either side), and with access to global coworking spaces.

• Work-Life Balance: Paid vacation and sick leave days

• Continuous Learning: Access to training programs, language courses, and learning sponsorship annually.

• Unique Projects: Work with cutting-edge blockchain technology in a global, diverse team.

ABOUT ROOTSTOCKLABS

RootstockLabs builds Bitcoin-secured DeFi infrastructure that enables companies and financial institutions to offer borrowing, lending, investment, and payment solutions at global scale.

• Market: Companies, financial institutions, and their customers

• Product: Bitcoin-secured DeFi financial products

• Distribution: B2B2C through regulated financial institutions

We operate at the intersection of crypto infrastructure and institutional finance, enabling compliant, scalable access to decentralized financial services powered by Bitcoin.

jobs.title: Senior Process Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US 


QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! 



As a Senior Process Integration Engineer, you will play a key role in translating new technologies and products from development into robust, scalable, and manufacturable processes. You will work closely with Engineering, R&D, Product, Operations, and Quality teams to develop, integrate, optimise, and release processes and products into manufacturing.

Your work will be essential in ensuring that new products and technologies can be reliably manufactured with the required performance, quality, and yield.



What you'll be doing

 - Lead the integration and transfer of new products, processes and technologies from R&D into manufacturing.

 - Define and develop manufacturing process flows, process specifications and control strategies for new product introductions.

 - Work closely with R&D and cross-functional teams to ensure new products are designed and released with manufacturability, quality and scalability in mind.

 - Plan and execute process integration activities, including process development, qualification, validation, and release.

 - Identify, investigate and resolve process integration issues, yield losses, and technical anomalies.

 - Drive continuous process and yield improvements using structured problem-solving and data-driven approaches.

 - Support the transition and scaling of manufacturing capabilities, including the implementation of new equipment, automation, and MES systems.

 - Develop and maintain key process and quality documentation, including Process FMEAs, Control Plans, process specifications, work instructions and change control documentation.

 - Participate in and support technical review and decision-making processes, including Change Control Boards (CCB) and Material Review Boards (MRB).

 - Work with Operations and Manufacturing teams to establish stable, repeatable, and scalable manufacturing processes.

 - Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers as the Process Integration team grows.
   

Your Profile

 - 4+ years of experience in Process Integration, Process Engineering, NPI, Yield Engineering, or a related engineering role.

 - A Master's or PhD degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Semiconductor Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.

 - Experience working in a semiconductor startup, microfabrication foundry, advanced manufacturing or other high-tech hardware environment.

 - Strong understanding of process development, process integration, qualification, and manufacturing transfer.

 - Experience with structured problem-solving and continuous improvement methodologies, including RCA, FMEA, SPC, DOE or similar tools.

 - Experience in analysing process and manufacturing data to identify root causes and improve process performance and yield.

 - Familiarity with quality and manufacturing systems, including Control Plans, non-conformance management, change control and corrective/preventive actions.

 - Experience working in cross-functional environments involving R&D, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality.

 - Strong technical problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.

 - Experience with semiconductor fabrication of superconducting devices or quantum technologies would be a nice to have. 

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. If this role excites you and you believe you can make an impact, we'd love to hear from you! 

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know this helps us with better decisions, more innovation, and strengthens our culture. In particular, we’d love to see more women in the quantum industry!

So if you’re a female talent, excited about this opportunity but don’t meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.
